jobs.title: Power Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary

Do you want to help clients unlock the value of automation, AI and low-code innovation? At Avanade, you’ll have the opportunity to design, build and deliver intelligent Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio solutions that improve how organisations work.

We are seeking a hands-on Power Platform Engineer to help establish and grow Power Platform capability for our clients, with a focus on Copilot Studio, automation, multi-agent solutions, apps, Dataverse and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical delivery experience with curiosity for emerging AI capabilities, practical knowledge of Power Platform and the confidence to work directly with business and technical stakeholders.

You will join a collaborative community of Microsoft specialists, engineers and consultants who are helping clients modernise processes, improve productivity and adopt AI responsibly.

About The Role

Avanade is the leading expert on Microsoft technologies. By joining Avanades UKDC , you will have a fantastic opportunity to operate at the forefront of technology, with access to the best clients across the world, working on challenging and exciting services.

We are a diverse team, and we are proud of our culture that welcomes every individual. In our teams you will find talented and passionate technologists, with a humble, collaborative, and positive attitude. We promise to invest in you and help give you the platform for continuous learning and development.

As a Power Platform Engineer, you will design and implement end-to-end Copilot Studio and Power Platform solutions that enable automation, intelligent assistance and process improvement for clients.

The role combines solution design, hands-on development, stakeholder engagement, requirements analysis, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

You will work across the full solution lifecycle—from discovery and requirements capture through to development, deployment, adoption, optimization and upskilling.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will:

Establish and grow client Power Platform capabilities, enabling powerful automation and AI functions across business teams.
Design and implement end-to-end Copilot Studio and Power Platform solutions, including automation and AI-enabled capabilities.
Develop multi-agent solutions, copilots, Canvas apps, Model-driven apps, Cloud Flows, Desktop Flows, Dataverse artefacts, AI Builder solutions, Business Process Flows and Power Pages.
Communicate with stakeholders to capture, analyse and document business and technical requirements.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve existing processes, helping clients gain efficiency and measurable value.
Engage directly with client and Avanade teams to share knowledge, support adoption and upskill others in Power Platform and AI capabilities.
Contribute to solution design, technical documentation, configuration, testing, deployment and ongoing optimisation.
Work collaboratively with architects, developers, consultants and client stakeholders in agile delivery environments.
Stay current with the latest Microsoft AI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform and wider Microsoft stack features, sharing insights across the practice.

Qualifications
:

Skills & Experience

We Are Looking For Candidates With:

.NET Technology
Experience working with Microsoft Copilot Studio / Power Virtual Agents.
Expertise in Power Automate Cloud Flows, Desktop Flows and computer use automation scenarios.
Expertise in Canvas app and Model-driven app development.
Experience working with Dataverse tables and data formats such as XML and JSON.
Competent understanding of Microsoft 365, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams and SharePoint-related infrastructure.

jobs.description:
2026-09-14

Vill du arbeta med den senaste teknologin och som del av ett scrum-team, med stöd av kompetenta och trevliga kollegor i en kreativ och internationell miljö? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som systemutvecklare på Uppsala universitet.

National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS) söker nu ytterligare 1 systemutvecklare. Vi är en nationell infrastruktur vars syfte är att tillhandahålla support för bioinformatiker och forskare inom livsvetenskaperna. Systemutvecklingsgruppen består av två scrumteam som utvecklar verktyg för storskalig datahantering och webbapplikationer för forskargrupper och EU-finansierade projekt, allt inom området bioinformatik.

Att vara en del av ett av våra team ger dig möjlighet att göra skillnad, genom att arbeta i projekt vars mål är att göra forskningsdata säker och delbar. Du kommer att vara anställd vid Uppsala universitet, på Institutionen för cell- och molekylärbiologi (ICM), och vara knuten till NBIS och Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab). Mer information om NBIS finns på https://nbis.se.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare kommer du att vara ansvarig för utveckling och underhåll av en delningsplattform för mänsklig genomikdata från forskningsprojekt, i samarbete med våra partners i andra europeiska länder. Målet med dessa projekt, som Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), är att hjälpa forskare att kunna dela sin data på ett säkert vis, och att på så sätt underlätta deras samarbeten runt mänsklig hälsa och medicin.

Projektet GDI handlar om att möjliggöra säker tillgång till genomiska och kliniska data inom EU, för att kunna förbättra klinisk diagnostik, behandlingar och prediktiv medicin. Bigpicture är ett annat europeiskt flaggskepp som syftar till att bygga en Petabyte plattform för AI inom digital patologi. Våra samarbetspartner kommer från akademin såväl som sjukvården och industrin.

Du kommer arbeta tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklare i ett av våra scrum-team och bidra till de ovan nämnda projekten. Scrum-teamet är ansvarig för produkternas hela livscykel, från planering och utveckling, till driftsättning och underhåll. Du kommer vara del av ett team som värdesätter kreativitet och ser gärna att du är med och påverkar alla beslut inom gruppen.

Kvalifikationskrav

Du som sökande skall minst ha kandidatexamen inom informationsteknik, datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller bioinformatik, alternativt motsvarande dokumenterad kompetens inom ett eller flera av dessa områden.

Vidare Krävs

Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i systemutveckling med Python och Java
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Kubernetes med Helm och Hashicorp Vault eller OpenBao
Minst fem års erfarenhet av databaser, t. ex. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet av virtualiseringslösningar och mjukvaru-containrar (t.ex. Docker eller Podman)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git och CI/CD (t. ex. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt enligt scrum och scrum-rollerna certifikat (scrummaster eller produktägare)
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Infrastructure as Code med Terraform och Ansible och ett eller flera molnleverantörer (t. ex. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
Minst fem års erfarenhet och god förståelse av nätverk (TLS, TCP/UDP, HTTPS, routing)
Att du kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet, den sökande ska ha mycket god samarbetsförmåga, initiativförmåga och goda kommunikativa kvaliteter.

Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt

Följande Räknas Som Meriterande

Vana att arbeta i fysiskt distribuerade team med kommunikation och koordination via elektroniska verktyg som videomöten och liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med informationssäkerhet är starkt meriterande
God förståelse av mekanismer för autentisering och auktorisation (t. ex. OAuth, JWT)
Kunskap om bioinformatik, i synnerhet är erfarenhet av verktyg och metoder för analys av human genomikdata särskilt efterfrågat.
Erfarenhet av verktyg för projektmanagement, t. ex. Zenhub, Jira.
Erfarenhet av arbete med infrastruktursystem för känsliga data, speciellt inom den offentliga sektorn eller akademin.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är tillsvidare (provanställning om 6 månader kan tillämpas). Omfattningen är heltid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort: Uppsala

Vår viktigaste tillgång är alla 7 500 anställda och 53 000 studenter som med nyfikenhet och engagemang gör Uppsala universitet till en av landets mest spännande arbetsplatser.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Own the backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix.

Oplane is an always-on security expert for AI-first engineering teams. Our biggest focus today is PR Analysis: every pull request reviewed against the customer’s architectural threat model before it merges, with findings and code-level fixes attached rather than a report handed over. Scanners find patterns. Oplane understands the system. That is where we are now, not where we stop, and we ship new capabilities constantly.

You are a senior hire on that backend. There is a working system with paying enterprise customers on it, so you are not starting from a blank repo, but large parts of it are still the first version that got us here and need someone senior to make them hold at scale.

What you’ll own
The backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix. Design, correctness, and the parts of reliability that live in the application layer.

What the job actually is
· Design and build the core backend. Python services, clean APIs, and the system design behind turning a customer’s code into a threat model and driving the fix. The analysis itself is AI-driven, so a lot of the interesting design is in orchestrating models reliably, not just moving data around. You own real system design here, not tickets handed to you fully specified.
· Build the APIs the product lives or dies by. Oplane only works when it is embedded in a customer’s repos, CI, pull request flow and coding agents. Part of that surface is how external coding agents talk to Oplane and run threat modeling directly. It has to be clean, stable, and hard to break, because other people’s pipelines and agents depend on it.
· Make it hold at enterprise scale. Companies with thousands of engineers, large codebases, concurrent analysis, and a lot of sensitive input passing through. You care about throughput, correct handling of customer code and secrets, and failure modes that do not silently drop a finding.
· Build the agentic way, because we mean it. This is the most agent-native codebase you are likely to have worked in. Our docs are written for coding agents to read, an agent reviews our pull requests, and we are building for a world where agents write most of the code. You will plan with an agent, build with one, and review with one, every day. We grow through agents rather than headcount, and if that reads as a threat to your craft rather than a multiplier of it, this is the wrong team.
· Work close to security. The whole product is about security architecture, and the team lives it, from prompt injection to secure-by-design, as a daily concern rather than an annual audit. You do not have to arrive as a security expert, but security experience is a real plus, and you should want to get good at it, because it is the domain the code is about.

Who this is for
· Around 10 years building backend systems in production. Depth in APIs, data, and system design matters more than any single language, and Python is a plus rather than a requirement.
· You think in architecture. You can hold a whole system in your head, see where it will break, own the design calls other people build on, and reason about a service end to end from data model to failure behavior.
· You can read what an AI agent produces and judge it. A lot of the code here is agent-written, and we need the architectural judgment to catch what it gets subtly wrong and steer it, rather than rubber-stamp it.
· You already use coding agents seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they do not. If you have not tried, this is the wrong team.
· Security experience is a strong plus. AppSec, secure design, working on a security product, or having been the person who reviewed everyone else’s threat model.
· Startup or scale-up background.
· Working language is English.

What you get
· A product with paying enterprise customers already running on the code you will own, so your work ships to real usage from week one. Teams like Miro, Tandem Health, Remotive Labs and Lightbringer already run Oplane, and we are SOC 2 certified.
· Real ownership of the backend, working directly with the founders.
· Backed by Seed Capital and Icebreaker.vc, with angel investors from Neo4j and Google, including Emil Eifrem. $5.2M seed.
· Based at our Malmö office, on-site five days a week. This is an in-person engineering team by design, not a distributed one.

How we work
Small team, ten of us today, real autonomy, and nothing between deciding something and doing it. We are honest about what is hard, including in this ad. We grow through agents rather than headcount, so the job is always to build the system that does the work rather than do the work by hand forever. Nobody here asks permission first. If you see it, do it, and tell us afterwards.

How to apply
Apply through the form on our site: https://www.oplane.com/careers/senior-backend-engineer
Use the Apply button on this post, which takes you there. We do not take applications through LinkedIn messages.

Tell us about a system you designed and one decision in it you would make differently now. Point us at code if you can.

jobs.description:
SMBC Group is a top-tier global financial group. Headquartered in Tokyo and with a 400-year history, SMBC Group offers a diverse range of financial services, including banking, leasing, securities, credit cards, and consumer finance. The Group has more than 130 offices and 80,000 employees worldwide in nearly 40 countries. Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. (SMFG) is the holding company of SMBC Group, which is one of the three largest banking groups in Japan. SMFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York (NYSE: SMFG) stock exchanges.

In the Americas, SMBC Group has a presence in the US, Canada, Ireland, Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, and Peru. Backed by the capital strength of SMBC Group and the value of its relationships in Asia, the Group offers a range of commercial and investment banking services to its corporate, institutional, and municipal clients. It connects a diverse client base to local markets and the organization’s extensive global network. The Group’s operating companies in the Americas include Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp. (SMBC), SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc., SMBC Capital Markets, Inc., SMBC MANUBANK, JRI America, Inc., SMBC Leasing and Finance, Inc., Banco Sumitomo Mitsui Brasileiro S.A., and Sumitomo Mitsui Finance and Leasing Co., Ltd.

This is a hybrid role, requiring the successful candidate to attend our Tralee office.

Role Description

SMBC is seeking a Full Stack .NET Developer to join its Development team in Tralee. The team develops and supports strategic and tactical applications that enable critical business processes across the organisation.

The successful candidate will have hands-on experience across the full technology stack, including web applications, user interfaces, backend services, REST APIs, databases and enterprise application support. Strong experience with C#/.NET, object-oriented programming, Oracle and/or SQL Server databases and complex SQL development is required.

The role will design, develop, enhance and support business applications, workflow solutions and system integrations. Working closely with business users, analysts, architects and development teams, the successful candidate will deliver scalable and reliable solutions within a global financial services environment.

jobs.title: Software developer
jobs.description:
Etsimme Sovelluskehittäjää
vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Sijainti:
Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

Vastuualueet

Sovelluskehittäjänä:

Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI-suunnittelijat.
Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

Kenen kanssa työskentelet?

Työskentelet osana T woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.

Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

Odotamme Sinulta

Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus.
Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: C#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript.
Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle.
Pilviosaamista: Azure tai AWS.
Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
Englannin kielen osaaminen.
Olet oma-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

Katsomme eduksi

Jos Sinulla On Kokemusta Jostain Seuraavista Osaamisista

Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
Integraatioista.
Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.

Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can-do -asenteella.

Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?

Ensimmäisen Kuuden Kuukauden Tavoitteesi Kiteytettynä

Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.
Olet päässyt hyvin osaksi työyhteisöä ja osoittautunut loistavaksi lisäksi tiimiimme.
Olet sisäistänyt asiakkaan toimialan ja perehtynyt sisään hankkeeseen.
Osaamisesi on osoittautunut relevantiksi asiakasprojekteissamme.

Auttaaksemme sinua menestymään, tarjoamme sinulle perehdytysohjelman, koulutuksia, sertifikaatteja sekä työyhteisön, joka omalla osaamisellaan ja tekemisellään tukee työssä oppimistasi ja urakehitystäsi. Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?

Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

Etuihimme Kuuluu

Markkinatasoinen työsuhde-etujen paketti sisältäen:
Lounas ja virike-etu
Työterveyshuolto
Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi

Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:
Online-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
Koulutukset ja community-tapaamiset
Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)

Paljon vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:
Koko firman tapahtumat
Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e-urheilu, padel.

Tehtävään Hakeminen

Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!

Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Onko sinulla kysymyksiä,
esimerkiksi hakemukseen tai toimiston esteettömyyteen liittyen, joihin toivoisit meidän vastaavan ennen hakemuksen jättämistä?

Voit ottaa yhteyttä rekrytointitiimiimme careers.fi@twoday.com ja palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian vastausten kera.

Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

Työskentely Twodaylla

Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Architect who designs comprehensive technical solutions to bridge business problems with technology, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, security, and scalability. In your work you create architecture blueprints, select technology stacks, and lead implementation teams, acting as a crucial link between stakeholders and developers.

The role is based in our Espoo or Tampere office, and the work will be done in a hybrid model according to our needs.

Your Main Responsibilities

Sales and presales: Identifying customer needs and proposing bold solutions.
Architecture Design: Creating detailed architecture specifications, diagrams, and documentation for software and infrastructure.
Strategic Alignment: Mapping business requirements to technical solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
Technology Selection: Evaluating and recommending tools, platforms, and frameworks that align with technical strategies.
Implementation Oversight: Guiding development teams during implementation to ensure adherence to the designed architecture.
Stakeholder Management: Communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and acting as a bridge between teams.

Your Required Skills And Experience

Technical Expertise: Strong background in software engineering (minimum 10 years), system integration, infrastructure, and cloud technologies (e.g., Azure, AWS).
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex problems and design effective, creative solutions.
Leadership: Ability and proven track-record in leading teams and guiding technical decision-making.
Project Management: Experience with SDLC, Agile methodologies, and managing project risks.
A Master’s degree in computer science or related field.
Extensive experience in software design, development, and IT infrastructure.
Experience in a technical leadership role.
Language skills: fluent English and Finnish

We also value

Entrepreneurial mindset
Deeper domain knowledge of industrial manufacturing

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 6000-7000€/month, depending on your background.

jobs.title: Erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Bygma tilbyder vi faglig dybde og geografisk bredde. Derfor har du store muligheder, når du vil lægge næste lag på din karriere. I salg eller i stab. På lager eller i ledelse. Sådan hjælper vi med at bygge Danmark.

Fastansat/tidsbegrænset: Fastansat

Timer: 37.0

Erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma Gruppen

Vil du udvikle digitale løsninger og samtidig tage ansvar for at drive udviklingsopgaver fremad sammen med teamet?

Vi søger en erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma IT & Digitalisering. Du bliver en del af vores interne udviklingsteam, hvor vi arbejder med alt fra websites, CMS og e-commerce til webapplikationer, API'er og integrationer.

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning - fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af Bygma IT & Digitalisering med ca. 35 kolleger og får en central rolle i udviklingsteamet med reference til Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov. Stillingen er med base på vores hovedkontor i Søborg.

Du arbejder selv hands-on med udviklingen og tager samtidig en drivende teknisk rolle i større opgaver. Sammen med interessenter og resten af teamet omsætter du behov fra forretningen til gode tekniske løsninger, får opgaverne brudt ned og bidrager til at skabe fremdrift hele vejen til implementering.

Vi arbejder tæt på forretningen og de løsninger, der er i brug hver dag. Derfor består jobbet både af nye udviklingsopgaver og den løbende videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger. Det betyder også, at du sammen med teamet tager fat på bugs, mindre forbedringer og konkrete forespørgsler fra forretningen, når de opstår.

Dine Opgaver Bliver Bl.a. At

udvikle og videreudvikle fullstack webapplikationer og digitale løsninger
tage ansvar for løsningsbeskrivelse og teknisk afklaring
nedbryde større udviklingsopgaver og drive dem fremad sammen med teamet

Din profil

Du har flere års erfaring med fullstack webudvikling og gerne solid erfaring med CMS og e-commerce.

Du trives med at arbejde på tværs af hele løsningen - fra brugerfladen i frontend til API'er, integrationer og data bagved.

Du trives med hele spændet i udviklingsarbejdet. Den ene opgave kan være en større ny funktion, den næste en fejl i en eksisterende løsning eller en konkret forespørgsel fra en kollega i forretningen. For dig er det naturligt at tage ansvar for begge dele.

Internet connected and smart home products are growing areas for Dyson where we aim to continue our reputation of being innovative and disruptive. Since our first launch of products in connected space, we have grown fast to several millions of connected machines, and we are envisioning a steep growth in 2026 and beyond both in scale and connected features.

We want to build reliable, scalable, and secure services and features to support these increasing demands with innovative and competitive technologies in IoT, Machine Data Lake, Data Analytics and Machine Learning to support our vision. We have a ‘You build it, you run it’ ethos and run all our services within Amazon Web Services (AWS). Our teams are responsible for the architecture, development, testing, and operational support of their services in all environments. We are a global department with teams located in the UK, Singapore, and China and we encourage flexible, independent, and innovative thinking in our engineers to deliver solutions.

About The Role

As a Cloud Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the Out of the Box experience of all Dyson Connected products, this includes pairing the Dyson Link app with connected products and building API and microservices for Connected products.

You will be using Node.js, C# or whatever is right for the job - to run in containers or as serverless functions within the AWS cloud. You will be responsible for features from inception to delivery, ensuring that all software produced is to the highest standard. You will be working collaboratively with the team in paired programming and mobbing sessions to ensure that we deliver the right solution for the problem at hand.

The team follow agile methodologies and are keen to ensure that the latest and best practices for software development are followed; all team members are encouraged to contribute to these evolving standards.

Designing, developing, testing and deploying micro-service applications
Monitoring, measuring and investigating production issues
Working in team-based development sessions to share knowledge and responsibilities
Encouraged to learn new technologies and skills as part of Personal Innovation time.

Sound foundation in Cloud Architecture and Development
Working experience with cloud platform (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)
Working experience with Docker or other virtualisation tools
Knowledgeable in cloud-native technologies: microservices, serverless computing, containers, APIs.
Good hands-on experience with continuous integration and delivery techniques and tools.
Good Knowledge in DotNet Core or NodeJS development
Experience in building production quality software
Exposure to or hands on knowledge with automated testing (Unit / Integration)
Familiarity with Agile working practices
Outstanding communication skills

Benefits

Dyson Singapore monitors the market to ensure competitive salaries and bonuses. Beyond that, you’ll enjoy a transport allowance and comprehensive medical care and insurance. But financial benefits are just the start of a Dyson career. Professional growth, leadership development and new opportunities abound, driven by regular reviews and dynamic workshops. Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. jobs.title: Mid-level Full-Stack Developer C#/.NET & Angular
jobs.description:
About Ragnar Solutions

Ragnar Solutions Romania is the Romanian branch of Ragnar Solutions BV, a growing software company based in the Netherlands.
We build and maintain Deimos
, an e-invoicing integration platform used for compliance accross PEPPOL (multi-country), France, Poland, Spain and more.
E-invoicing is becoming mandatory in more and more countries, but every country has different rules, formats, and government systems. Deimos handles that complexity for our clients, helping make sure
their invoices are processed correctly and delivered to the right systems on time.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-level Full-Stack Developer
to join the team building Deimos.
You will own features end to end: from the CSV/SFTP intake and the background jobs that talk to national e-invoicing systems (Poland's KSeF, Spain's VeriFactu, the Peppol network) through to the Angular portals where clients see the result.

Our Stack

How it's built

A multi-tenant platform: two Angular portals (client and admin), an API gateway in front of two ASP.NET Core APIs, and multiple .NET background services
Services talk over RabbitMQ; calls to external systems go through an outbox with idempotent retries
Integrations over REST, SOAP and SFTP, with XML built and validated against official schemas (Peppol BIS / UBL, Poland's FA(3))

Backend

C# 14 on .NET 10, ASP.NET Core
Entity Framework Core with PostgreSQL
RabbitMQ, Serilog
xUnit and Moq

Front-end

Angular 20, standalone components and signals
TypeScript, RxJS, Tailwind CSS
Nx monorepo with libraries shared by both portals
Playwright for end-to-end tests

Tooling and Infrastructure

Docker and Docker Compose
GitLab CI for builds, tests and deployments
HashiCorp Vault for configuration and secrets

What you will do

Own features across backend, frontend, tests and docs
Build and maintain integrations with national e-invoicing authorities
Work with XML schemas: build documents, validate them, debug rejections from the authority
Design background jobs: import pipelines, outbox-based sync workers, retries, idempotency
Investigate production issues independently across services (logs, queues, database)
Keep tenant isolation and authorization intact in everything you touch
Review code and mentor junior developers

What we are looking for

3+ years professional C#/.NET, including ASP.NET Core APIs
Solid EF Core and relational DB skills (PostgreSQL preferred): migrations, indexing, query performance
Angular + TypeScript + RxJS, comfortable with forms, tables, reusable components; signals a plus
Message-based / asynchronous processing (RabbitMQ or similar): at-least-once delivery, idempotency, retries
Unit and integration tests as part of "done" (xUnit, Moq)
Comfortable integrating third-party APIs (REST, SOAP) and reading XML/XSD
Can debug a distributed issue on your own
Git/PR workflow, gives useful code review

Nice to have

E-invoicing, Peppol, UBL or any tax-authority integration
Multi-tenant SaaS
Docker Compose, GitLab CI, Vault
File-based integrations (SFTP, CSV)
Auth: JWT, FIDO2/passkeys, RBAC
Nx monorepos, Playwright

What we offer

Salary range between 7000 and 11000 RON (net), depending on experience
Hybrid working environment
Meal tickets
Medlife Gold private medical insurance
End of year bonus
Performance bonus
Access to courses for continued professional development

Our hiring process

We keep it short and transparent:

Intro call to talk about your background, the role, and what you are looking for.
Take-home assignment, described below.
Technical discussion (around an hour) where we go through your assignment together.
Final conversation with the team, and an offer.

About the take-home assignment

The assignment is a small full-stack task scoped to around 4 hours: a .NET API that accepts invoice-like records, a background worker that processes them from a queue (idempotent, with retries), and a small Angular page that shows the outcome. We care about how you structure and test it, not about polish. You have one week to hand it in.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Turkey.

This is a strategic and advisory architecture role focused on shaping complex, multi-domain platforms for scalability, security, reliability, and long-term sustainability.

You will define architecture strategy, technical roadmaps, and reference patterns while guiding engineering teams through complex technical decisions.

The role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.

You will bridge pre-sales and delivery, ensuring client solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with long-term platform realities.

While the position is primarily architecture-focused, you will remain hands-on when greenfield initiatives, prototypes, or critical architectural decisions require deeper technical involvement.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Benefits

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to broader engineering maturity and leadership development.

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

Do

Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally

Senior .NET Developer

The Role:

As a Senior .Net Developer you will join our team to help us deliver high quality code for new and existing projects. Your main focus will be the development and refactoring of backend-services using C# .NET (full framework, .NET6) and supporting application delivery to multiple environments.

The main responsibilities of the position include:

Full stack design and the implementation of key internal applications
Identify, troubleshoot and debug defects in designated application code
Write reusable, testable, clean and documented code, utilising prescribed coding conventions
Follow test driven development, continuous integration and agile methodologies
Participate in peer code reviews

Main requirements:

BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related subject
At least 4 years of experience in Microsoft .NET (full framework, .NET Core, .NET 6)
Proficiency in object-oriented programming (C#) and web concepts (Http, MVC, REST, OAuth)
Knowledge of and an active interest in Design Patterns and SOLID architecture principles
Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills
Dynamic and target oriented

The following will be considered an advantage:

Experience with microservices architecture (Clean Architecture, CQRS)
A strong background in relational database theory and excellent knowledge of Relational Databases (SQL Server/MYSQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL)
Experience with communication protocols like GraphQL, GRPC
Experience with asynchronous pub-sub message bus architectures such as RabbitMQ Kafka or equivalent
Experience with C++/CLI
Experience with Python
Hands-on working experience with the MT5 Manager API, including its quirks: cache vs server-side semantics, pump modes
Broad working knowledge of the MT5 platform overall symbols, groups, gateways, feeders, dealers, automations

Benefit from:

Attractive relocation package and support for a smooth relocation for you and your family

Wat breng jij mee?

We zoeken een Integrations Specialist die technische expertise combineert met een pragmatische mindset en sterke communicatieve skills.
Je hebt een grondige kennis van DevOps-principes en ervaring met Microsoft-integratiepatronen en -componenten zoals API Management, Service Bus en iPaaS.
Je hebt ervaring met het ApiOps-framework van Microsoft, inclusief Spectral Linting.
Je werkt vlot met Infrastructure as Code, bij voorkeur met Terraform en Bicep binnen Azure DevOps.

Je communiceert helder, neemt collega’s mee in je verhaal en inspireert teams om samen vooruit te gaan.
Je spreekt en schrijft vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.

We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren.

Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan.

Continu bijleren: door innovation centers, leesgroepen, knowledge sharing meetings, hackatons, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen zetten we kennisdeling en bijleren centraal.

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead architecture design, drive technology decisions, and co-create innovative products while mentoring clients to adopt Agile practices and engineering excellence. Your role offers hands-on collaboration, diverse industry exposure, and opportunities to shape solutions and grow as a technology leader.

Job Purpose

The Senior OneStream Developer
will play a key role in TD SYNNEX's global Finance transformation, supporting the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of the company's OneStream platform. Working closely with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders, this role will design and deliver scalable solutions that support financial consolidation, close, planning, forecasting, reporting, and other critical Finance processes.

As part of a global Finance Systems team, the successful candidate will contribute to strategic initiatives, continuous improvement efforts, and the delivery of a reliable, high-performing EPM environment supporting users across multiple regions.

Design, develop, and maintain OneStream solutions including Business Rules, Finance Rules, Extender Rules, Dashboard XFBRs, Cube Views, Workflows, Data Management Sequences, and Integrations.

Develop and maintain integrations between OneStream and ERP, HRIS, Data Warehouse, and other enterprise applications using SQL, flat files, REST APIs, and integration tools.
Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Participate in solution design, technical analysis, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support activities.

Support critical financial close, forecasting, and planning cycles while providing production support for a global user community across EMEA, Americas, and APAC time zones.

Required

6+ years of experience developing and supporting Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) platforms.

Experience with alternative EPM technologies such as Oracle Hyperion/HFM, Oracle EPM Cloud, SAP BPC, IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), or similar platforms.
Strong experience developing OneStream Business Rules, Finance Rules, Extender Rules, Dashboard XFBRs, Cube Views, Workflows, Data Management Sequences, and Integration solutions.
Strong programming experience with VB.NET.
Advanced SQL development and database skills.
Experience developing and supporting integrations between OneStream and enterprise applications.
Experience working with OneStream metadata, dimensional modeling, security, and application administration concepts.
Solid understanding of financial close, consolidation, planning, forecasting, account reconciliations, and management reporting processes.
Experience troubleshooting, optimizing, and supporting enterprise financial applications
Experience working within Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes including testing, deployment, release management, and change management.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Accounting, IT, and business stakeholders.
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred

Experience participating in one or more full-cycle OneStream implementations.
Experience supporting OneStream Cloud (SaaS) environments.
Experience with REST APIs, XML, JSON, PowerShell, or other integration technologies.
Experience with source control and release management practices.
Experience supporting global Finance transformation programs.
Experience working in large multinational organizations.
Knowledge of SAP, Oracle, Workday, or other enterprise ERP platforms.
Experience working within distributed global teams.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Portugal.

This is a strategic and advisory architecture role focused on shaping complex, multi-domain platforms for scalability, security, reliability, and long-term sustainability.

You will define architecture strategy, technical roadmaps, and reference patterns while guiding engineering teams through complex technical decisions.

The role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.

You will bridge pre-sales and delivery, ensuring client solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with long-term platform realities.

While the position is primarily architecture-focused, you will remain hands-on when greenfield initiatives, prototypes, or critical architectural decisions require deeper technical involvement.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Benefits

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to broader engineering maturity and leadership development.

Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

Project Description:

The Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) system is a cloud native software platform whose main task is the automation of business processes. FARO is based on a microservice architecture written in C# .NET. It provides process control (so called MissionScheduler) and connects to 3rd party systems in the environment of the processes (so called connectors). In the future FARO will enable our new process platform Camunda with connectors. The team in addition to developing connectors for FARO will also be responsible to develop templates and APIs for Camunda.

Activity Description:

As a Fullstack engineer you are part of a team which is responsible for process automation for fixed access network projects within Telekom Deutschland. You will be part of an innovative and agile work environment where you will be implementing future-oriented software solutions to manage and plan the hardware rollout for the fixed access network.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend microservices using C# .NET within a Kubernetes-orchestrated environment
Implement and improve traceability, observability, and stability of the growing microservice architecture through monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Dapr
Develop and enhance frontend components using Angular to deliver responsive user interfaces and support rapid feature deployment
Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration connectors for FARO and Camunda process automation platform
Model, configure, and optimise business processes using BPMN standards within the Camunda ecosystem
Containerise applications using Docker and manage deployment pipelines within Kubernetes clusters
Conduct code reviews, share technical expertise, and provide constructive feedback throughout the development lifecycle to maintain code quality and team growth
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks and system issues across the microservice architecture
Contribute to the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation processes
Drive innovation by evaluating and implementing emerging technologies and best practices in software development, including design patterns, clean code principles, and test-driven development

Qualifications

Must-Have Skills:

Phi Partners is a global capital markets technology consultancy, offering a range of services, technology solutions, and advisory support to investment banks, hedge funds, and asset managers. We specialize in delivering robust, scalable, and cloud-based solutions, supporting clients across their digital transformation journeys.

About the Role

Phi Partners is supporting one of the world’s largest, most influential sovereign wealth funds that has a diverse portfolio covering every asset class across every major geographical region globally. Our client is building a low-latency, event-driven trading platform on Azure. The programme focuses on delivering a high-performance, regulated architecture using Solace messaging, AKS and cloud-native services. This role will perform the end-to-end quality & automation testing and compliance assurance for the data platforms and ETL pipelines linked to the trading platform, ensuring the platform meets performance, resiliency and audit requirements for regulated markets.

Define and execute test strategy across unit, integration, contract, E2E, and performance for the data platforms (databricks, snowflake) and ETL pipelines.

Automate data quality checks for market/reference data, order/trade states, and downstream stores (SQL Server/Azure SQL).
Implement reconciliation across OMS/EMS, risk, and settlement; verify lineage and PII/PCI masking where relevant.

Manage golden datasets and synthetic market data at scale for repeatable regression.

Experience with implementing and defining test automation strategies for data platforms.

QuickFIX/N (FIX testing), schema registry tools, ISTQB Advanced/CSTE, Azure certifications, Agile/Scrum.

Job PurposeThe Technical Architect is responsible for defining and guiding the technical and application architecture for enterprise solutions. The role translates business requirements into scalable, secure, and practical solution designs across applications, integrations, cloud platforms, data flows, and enterprise systems.

Key Focus Areas:

Application Architecture
Solution Design
AI Enabled Application Architecture
Application Modernization
Cloud and Platform Enablement
Cross Domain Application Alignment
Infrastructure and Security Driven Application Design
Drive Innovation

Job Description
Application Architecture

Design end-to-end application architectures across enterprise platforms, custom applications, SaaS solutions, cloud services, and digital systems
Define application architecture standards, patterns, and best practices for modular design, service design, maintainability, scalability, performance, reliability, and supportability
Guide teams on application structure, component design, technology selection, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles
Ensure application designs support business capabilities, operational needs, security expectations, and long-term technology direction

Application Solution Design

Translate business requirements into practical end-to-end technical designs and solution options
Evaluate solution alternatives, identify technical risks, assess cost versus benefit, and recommend fit-for-purpose architecture decisions
Create solution designs that consider applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure, security, operations, and delivery constraints
Provide technical guidance during delivery to ensure the implemented solution remains aligned with the approved design

AI Enabled Application Architecture

Identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation, machine learning, and generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business processes
Guide application teams on AI enabled solution patterns, including intelligent search, document processing, recommendation engines, conversational interfaces, workflow automation, and decision support
Ensure AI-enabled application designs consider data quality, privacy, security, access control, auditability, explainability, operational support, and responsible AI principles
Work with data, integration, security, infrastructure, and platform teams to ensure AI solutions are properly connected to enterprise data, APIs, cloud services, and application platforms
Support evaluation of AI tools, platforms, APIs, and vendor capabilities to determine fit-for-purpose use cases and enterprise adoption
Ensure AI capabilities are designed as part of the application architecture, not as disconnected experiments or standalone proof of concepts

Application Modernization

Support legacy application assessment, rationalization, modernization, and simplification initiatives
Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, remove duplication, consolidate platforms, and improve application maintainability
Guide modernization approaches including replatforming, refactoring, replacement, cloud adoption, containerization, and service enablement
Partner with business and technology teams to define practical transition states from current architecture to target architecture

Infrastructure and Security Aware Application Design

Ensure application designs properly consider hosting, compute, storage, network, identity, access, security controls, performance, resilience, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and operational support requirements
Work closely with infrastructure and security architects to align application designs with enterprise infrastructure, cloud, network, and security standards
Incorporate security by design principles including identity and access management, role based access, encryption, secure APIs, data protection, vulnerability management, and compliance needs
Validate that applications are designed for availability, scalability, observability, supportability, and production readiness

Cloud and Platform Enablement

Guide the use of cloud services, enterprise platforms, DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, environment strategy, and deployment patterns
Support application teams in adopting cloud native and platform capabilities where they provide business and technical value
Ensure cloud and platform choices are secure, scalable, cost effective, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards
Collaborate with platform, DevOps, infrastructure, and engineering teams to improve delivery speed, reliability, and operational maturity

Cross Domain Application Alignment

Work closely with enterprise, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and platform architects to ensure application solutions are aligned across the broader technology landscape
Ensure application designs properly address integration points, data movement, master data needs, reporting dependencies, security controls, infrastructure impact, and operational dependencies
Maintain clear ownership boundaries with specialized architecture domains while ensuring end-to-end solution integrity
Identify reuse opportunities across applications, platforms, services, APIs, and shared technical capabilities

Architecture Governance & Compliance Alignment

Work with the Architecture Review Board, enterprise architecture team, and domain architects to ensure application and technical solution designs follow approved architecture standards, principles, and governance processes
Support architecture review submissions by preparing solution architecture documents, design diagrams, technical decision records, risk assessments, and required review materials
Review application and technical designs for alignment with enterprise standards across application architecture, integration, data, infrastructure, security, cloud, and operational readiness
Identify architecture risks, design gaps, technical debt, compliance concerns, and operational impacts early in the solution lifecycle
Ensure application solutions consider security, privacy, data protection, resilience, disaster recovery, audit, and regulatory requirements in partnership with the relevant domain owners
Track architecture decisions, exceptions, risks, and follow-up actions through the appropriate governance forums and delivery checkpoints

Leadership & Collaboration

Serve as subject matter expert and technical advisor for infrastructure and security initiatives
Mentor engineering teams on architecture principles, security best practices, and technology adoption
Collaborate with enterprise architects, application teams, and business stakeholders to align technical solutions with business needs
Lead architectural reviews, provide technical guidance, and resolve design conflicts
Stay current with industry trends, emerging threats, and innovative technologies

Documentation & Knowledge Management

Create and maintain solution architecture documents, application architecture diagrams, system context diagrams, data flow diagrams, deployment views, technical design documents, and architecture decision records
Document key design decisions, architecture assumptions, technical risks, dependencies, exceptions, standards, reusable patterns, and open issues
Maintain architecture artifacts required for Architecture Review Board reviews, delivery governance, production readiness, operational handover, and future system changes
Document application design standards, technical patterns, operational guidelines, and support considerations in collaboration with architecture and engineering teams
Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and capability building programs for engineering, product, delivery, and technical teams

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Relevant Job Experience
Professional Experience

10 plus years of experience in application development, technical architecture, solution architecture, enterprise systems, or technology delivery roles
5 plus years of experience in application architecture, technical solution design, or enterprise wide solution architecture
Proven experience designing and delivering large scale enterprise application solutions across custom applications, SaaS platforms, cloud services, and packaged business systems
Strong experience translating business requirements into end-to-end technical designs covering applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure, security, cloud, and operations
Experience working with Architecture Review Boards, enterprise architecture teams, and domain architects to review, govern, and align solution designs
Strong background in application modernization, platform consolidation, cloud adoption, technical debt reduction, and legacy system rationalization
Practical experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including application hosting, deployment patterns, scalability, security, monitoring, and cost awareness
Experience working with integration teams on APIs, middleware, event based flows, data exchange, and system interaction patterns
Experience guiding engineering teams on application design, technical patterns, DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, testing, deployment, and production readiness
Retail, ecommerce, hospitality, supply chain, or enterprise business systems experience strongly preferred

Application Architecture: Enterprise applications, custom platforms, SaaS solutions, packaged systems, modular design, service design, API first architecture, scalability, maintainability, and supportability
Solution Design: End to end technical design, solution options, architecture tradeoffs, risk assessment, cost versus benefit analysis, transition architecture, and implementation guidance

jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!

Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
