Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day.

We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. You’ll make a real difference in the lives of millions of people. Together with our customers, we help to advance sustainability, health, justice, prosperity, and commerce around the world.

You can thrive at Wolters Kluwer, where diversity is core to our collective strength and high performance. Be your unique self, share your creative ideas, do your best work, and take time to grow in our caring and inclusive culture where you can belong.

About This Role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production, mentor less experienced engineers, and lead by example. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI

In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI
—a medical research and clinical reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point‑of‑care knowledge resource into a real‑time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

What You’ll Do

Design and implement full‑stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.
Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).
Apply secure SDLC and privacy‑by‑design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).
Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer‑focused solutions with measurable outcomes.
Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
Lead by example and be heavily hands-on: drive architecture, mentor engineers, and take ownership of larger projects.

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
AI Agent development and evaluation
Backend development
Frontend development
Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Quality engineering / testing strategy
Secure SDLC and privacy by design

Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast-paced team.
Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-tuning and model adaptation.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

1× systems design

Typically 2–4 weeks

expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.

and ambitions.

along with a brief cover letter

Your role and the problem space you were working in

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information
in your submission

Be the Difference | If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

We’re seeking passionate, top-tier professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, creative, and collaborative environment. If you want to build cutting-edge airspace security innovation alongside the best engineers in the industry, this is your place.

Job Description

The Role:

We are building a powerhouse Cloud/Platform team in Krakow, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
to be a part of this group. You will play a crucial role in implementing, maintaining, and scaling a massive multi-tenant SaaS distributed ecosystem
,
migrating on-premise components into a modern cloud architecture.

We are looking for a highly adaptable, heavyweight engineer who is "hot on code"
and loves being deeply hands-on.

As a Senior Engineer in this elite team, you must be:

Highly Adaptable: Completely comfortable and highly effective in a rapidly changing, dynamic environment.
A Fast Learner: Able to quickly absorb new domain knowledge and master new technologies on the fly.
Decisive: Capable of making quick, pragmatic, and highly technical decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysis.
A Team Player: Ready to collaborate effectively with top-tier engineers, sharing knowledge, and driving collective success.

(Note: While this role is heavily focused on backend engineering and cloud infrastructure, we operate with a strict 'You Build It, You Run It'
culture. End-to-end ownership is key, and you will occasionally dive into the frontend (React) to deliver complete features).

What You Will Do

Drive the Cloud Transition: Play a hands-on role in building and running multi-tenant SaaS applications designed specifically to take full advantage of cloud-native architecture.
Build Distributed Systems: Implement highly complex, high-throughput backend services and distributed systems, ensuring seamless data flow across Cloud, On-Premise, and Edge layers.
Write Exceptional Code: Write sharp, scalable, and maintainable code. You will help set and maintain the highest engineering standards.
End-to-End Ownership: Take full ownership of your features - from technical design and backend coding to automated deployment and production monitoring.
Collaborate & Accelerate: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior peers across MSI and D-Fend to leverage shared expertise, unblock technical challenges, and deliver results rapidly.

Basic Requirements

Requirements

Experience & Mindset: 5+ years of backend engineering experience. You thrive in a dynamic environment, make quick, pragmatic technical decisions, and excel at collaborating with top-tier engineers.
The Core Stack: Expertise in Node.js and TypeScript (including frameworks like NestJS or Express). You are highly hands-on and write extremely clean, scalable code.
Cloud & Observability: Strong experience building event-driven microservices in a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) and implementing modern Cloud Observability patterns (metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging).
Data & Infrastructure: Solid proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-memory caching (Redis), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
End-to-End Ownership: Practical experience with (or a strong willingness to touch) React to help the team deliver complete, end-to-end features when necessary.

Big Advantages (Bonus Points)

Infrastructure as Code: Experience treating infrastructure as software using Terraform, AWS CDK, or Serverless Framework.
AI Tooling: Experience enriching and optimizing development using dev-assisting GenAI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude or Cursor).
Security & ZTA: Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and mTLS.
Data Scale: Experience with time-series telemetry pipelines and long-term storage tiering.
Observability: Experience implementing and utilizing observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).

Private medical coverage with dental package
Life insurance, MultiSport card
IP Tax Relief

Yearly bonus (depends on company performance)

Great team atmosphere (small scrum teams)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.
The Import Export organization builds and scales infrastructure for secure, reliable, high-throughput data movement across RelativityOne.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products.
You will collaborate with a senior engineering team and business stakeholders to build features and services that evolve RelativityOne SaaS.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design architecture and non-functional aspects of Import/Export services aligned with SLO/SLA targets
Break down complex problems into resilient, cloud-native designs and deliver measurable outcomes
Mentor team members on code quality, best practices, and technical debt management
Own production systems, including on-call responsibilities, root cause analysis, and proactive issue resolution
Drive operational excellence through observability, alerting automation, and reliable metrics
Collaborate with Product to shape roadmap decisions using data and clear trade-offs
Improve CI/CD processes through automation and predictable, compliant deployments

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience building C#/.NET or similar services with demonstrated reliability or performance improvements
Experience designing distributed SaaS systems and translating business needs into technical solutions
Production ownership experience, including on-call rotations, incident response, and reducing MTTR using telemetry
Experience delivering cloud-native systems (Azure or similar platforms)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, testing, and deployment governance
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
English proficiency for technical communication

Preferred

Experience leading microservices development for high-volume, event-driven systems
Experience scaling ingestion pipelines, ETL workflows, or data processing systems with measurable outcomes
Experience mentoring teams in agile planning and cross-team collaboration

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

The Import Export organization is a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales the infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within an established senior engineering team and partner with business stakeholders to develop the products, features, and services that drive and evolve RelativityOne.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Create architecture and non-functional designs for Import/Export services that meet SLO and SLA targets.
Decompose complex problems into resilient, cloud-native solutions and deliver milestones with measurable outcomes.
Advise and mentor team members on code quality, technical debt management, and engineering best practices.
Own production systems by leading on-call activities, root cause analyses, and proactive issue resolution efforts that reduce MTTR.
Drive operational excellence by leveraging observability data to prioritize work, automate alerts, and expose trustworthy metrics.
Partner with Product to shape the roadmap through clear trade-off discussions and data-backed decisions.
Optimize CI/CD practices by designing automation that keeps deployments predictable and compliant.

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience delivering C#/.NET services or similar technologies with measurable reliability or performance improvements.
Experience architecting distributed SaaS systems and translating business requirements into resilient technical designs.
Proven production ownership experience, including leading on-call rotations, conducting root cause analyses, and using telemetry to reduce MTTR and incident volume.
Experience building and operating cloud-native solutions (Azure experience is a plus; any major cloud platform is acceptable).
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, automated testing, and deployment governance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Fluency in English with strong technical communication skills.

Preferred

Experience leading microservice initiatives for high-volume, event-driven workloads.
Experience scaling ingestion platforms, data pipelines, or ETL workflows with measurable outcomes.
Experience mentoring engineers and supporting agile planning and cross-team collaboration.

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

Backendutvecklare – dags att göra avtryck i höst!

När löven börjar skifta färg, luften blir krispigare och hösten drar igång är det också ett perfekt tillfälle att blicka framåt – mot nya möjligheter, spännande teknik och nästa steg i karriären. På HiQ tror vi att hösten är tiden då nya idéer tar fart och vår växa. 🍁

Vi kombinerar spetskompetens inom IT med en kultur där det finns utrymme för både nyfikenhet och lekfullhet. Hos oss får du bidra med din expertis, växa i din roll och utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor som värdesätter samarbete högt.

Nu söker vi en erfaren backendutvecklare som vill vara en del av vår resa och sätta sin prägel på framtidens lösningar. 🚀

Såhär kommer du att bidra

Som backendutvecklare på HiQ blir du en viktig pusselbit i konsultuppdrag som sträcker sig över olika branscher – från fordon och medtech till offentlig sektor och finans. Vissa uppdrag handlar om att bygga helt nya plattformar från grunden och andra om att vidareutveckla och optimera befintliga system.

Du kommer att:

Skapa och förvalta robusta, skalbara och säkra backendlösningar.
Jobba nära kollegor inom bland annat arkitektur, frontend, test och UX för att skapa helhetslösningar.
Få möjlighet att utforska olika branscher och bolag, samt testa på olika tekniker.
Dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra.
Vara med i tekniska diskussioner och bidra till hur både kunden och vi på HiQ kan bli ännu bättre.

Matchar vi?

Vi letar efter en utvecklare med minst 5 års erfarenhet inom backendutveckling, som gillar att grotta ner sig i kod men också att se den större bilden. Du har erfarenhet av flera eller några av dessa tekniker:

Java (Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Kubernetes)
Node.js (Javascript, Typescript)
C# (.NET, ASP.NET, .NET Core)

För att skapa system som är skalbara, säkra och hållbara över tid krävs att du har erfarenhet och kunskap inom Cloudteknologier som Azure, AWS eller GCP. ☁️

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, flexibel och kommunikativ. Du uppskattar gemenskapen i ett team, men kan också ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du är flytande i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

Är du vår nästa HiQare?

I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Om du vill bygga framtidens digitala lösningar, utveckla din kompetens och samtidigt vara en del av ett gäng som tror att skratt, kaffe och kreativitet går hand i hand – då vill vi höra från dig!

👉 Skicka in din ansökan idag och bli en del av HiQ-gemenskapen!

Sist men inte minst!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla - oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv till bordet. Hoppas vi hörs snart!

Vissa uppdrag handlar om att bygga helt nya plattformar från grunden och andra om att vidareutveckla och optimera befintliga system.

Du kommer att:

Skapa och förvalta robusta, skalbara och säkra backendlösningar.
Jobba nära kollegor inom bland annat arkitektur, frontend, test och UX för att skapa helhetslösningar.
Få möjlighet att utforska olika branscher och bolag, samt testa på olika tekniker.
Dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra.
Vara med i tekniska diskussioner och bidra till hur både kunden och vi på HiQ kan bli ännu bättre.

Matchar vi?

Vi letar efter en utvecklare med minst 7 års erfarenhet inom backendutveckling, som gillar att grotta ner sig i kod men också att se den större bilden. Du har erfarenhet av flera eller några av dessa tekniker:

C# (.NET, ASP.NET, .NET Core)
C++ (Linux)
Python/Golang (Django, Flask)

För att skapa system som är skalbara, säkra och hållbara över tid krävs att du har erfarenhet och kunskap inom Cloudteknologier som Azure, AWS eller GCP. ☁️

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, flexibel och kommunikativ. Du uppskattar gemenskapen i ett team, men kan också ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du är flytande i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

jobs.title: Senior cloud-focused Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The job

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join us in building our automation and communication platform. We help solve our customers communication needs by automating repetitive tasks in help desk, sales and marketing. We are looking to do a technical shift and move parts of it to kubernetes running on AWS - do you wanna be part of it from the start?

Software is the core part of our business at Lime and we work together in a cross-functional team for the engineering teams to get the business input. Together with our Product Owners we use ShapeUp as the agile methodology. We meet regularly and decide what’s essential to the product and how it should evolve.

The Engineers at Lime are problem solvers who strive to understand how everything fits together. We do pragmatic solutions to hard problems, a good mix of freedom and responsibility, and most importantly – have a great time at work! We are encouraged to come up with new ideas and experiment a lot. We think long-term and our ambition is to write clean and maintainable code. We take ownership of architecture and automated testing.

We always stick to the “best tool for the problem” approach – we listen to industry trends with interest, but evaluate if something is right for us. We do things that matter to our customers and maintain a vision to stay on the right path.

Requirements

Skills & Requirements

Our main stack

C#
Vue
TypeScript
MS SQL
Redis

Its a real plus if you

Have experience with developing and hosting SaaS solutions on AWS, setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and previous experience in taking architectural responsibilities in projects

Our process

We have a lightweight process using the latest Agile techniques with stable feature cycles, no deadlines and an emphasis on understanding the actual problem rather than specifications.

Even though we try our best, our tech and processes are far from perfect. That’s why we are looking for like-minded craftspeople to join us on the journey to building a company and product we can be proud of!

What We Offer

A stable and calm working environment
Ergonomic workplace equipment
Continuous education in the latest techs
Promote personal skill development with various activities
Commuter friendly offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Lund

📍 Gothenburg | Hybrid | Permanent

We're working with a growing boutique technology consultancy
in Gothenburg that's looking for a Senior Integration Specialist / Backend Developer to join its engineering team.

This isn't a standard backend role.

You'll be helping design and build an integration platform connecting external software with complex enterprise systems

.

You'll ideally bring:
Strong backend development experience with Java or C#/.NET

Proven API development and system integration
experience

Most importantly, you'll be someone who is confident, consultative and happy to have an opinion

Flexible guaranteed + performance-linked model

The project operates within a security-sensitive environment, so formal security vetting and assignment eligibility requirements apply.

Apply directly.

jobs.title: Azure Integration Architect
jobs.description:
Vi omdefinierar vad ett datakonsultbolag kan vara och åstadkomma

Epical är inte bara ännu ett konsultbolag. Vi har en tydlig ambition: att omdefiniera vad ett datakonsultbolag kan vara och åstadkomma. Allt vi gör börjar och slutar med förtroende. För oss är förtroende inte bara ett värdeord, det är grunden för varje framgångsrikt samarbete. Som konsulter handlar vårt jobb om mer än att leverera tjänster och rådgivning. Vi tar ansvar och ser möjligheter att bidra till en mer rättvis värld genom vår expertis inom integration, dataanalys och digitalt förtroende.

Är du en affärsorienterad integrationsarkitekt som brinner för att skapa värde genom smarta integrationslösningar? Hos Epical får du arbeta med kunder i olika branscher och utvecklas tillsammans med några av branschens främsta integrationsexperter.

Din roll som Azure Integration Architect

Som Azure Integration Architect hos Epical får du en nyckelroll inom:

Rådgivning kring integrationsarkitektur Du samarbetar med kunder för att utforma och implementera integrations-, och API-arkitekturer som matchar deras unika behov och ambitioner.
Ledning av teknisk leverans Du guidar ditt team genom hela resan; från planering och kravanalys, till design och implementation, samtidigt som du säkerställer smidiga lösningar med verklig effekt.
Presales Du visar upp Epicals integrationsexpertis och skapar förtroende och engagemang hos potentiella kunder.
Samarbete i team Du leder arbetsgrupper och främjar en kultur av lärande och gemensam framgång inom vår teambaserade leveransmodell.

Vi är stolta över att leverera integrationslösningar av hög kvalitet på flera olika molnplattformar. I takt med att vi växer tar vi oss an alltmer komplexa projekt i dynamiska miljöer. Oavsett om du föredrar en teknisk, handfast roll, ett strategiskt rådgivande fokus, eller en kombination av båda, på Epical kan vi skräddarsy din roll utifrån dina styrkor och ambitioner.

Vad vi letar efter

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen bör du ha:

Flera års praktisk erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services (AIS) och dess centrala komponenter (expempelvis Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid och Functions)
Förmåga att balansera både helhetsbilden och kundens detaljerade krav, och säkerställa lösningar som möter affärsmål samtidigt som de är tekniskt robusta.
Dokumenterad ledarerfarenhet, med vana att guida och coacha tekniska leveransteam genom hela integrationsprojekt.
Teknisk bakgrund som gör att du förstår utvecklingsprocesser och arkitekturer, även om du inte längre kodar dagligen.
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift, med förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och professionellt i olika sammanhang.

Det är meriterande om du har
erfarenhet av att arbeta i en konsultmiljö samt med BizTalk eller bredare kompetens inom Azure-plattformen

Varför välja Epical?

Hos Epical står förtroende och samarbete i centrum för allt vi gör. Här är vad du kan förvänta dig som en del av vårt team:

Work-life balance: Flexibla möjligheter att arbeta hemifrån och en arbetsmiljö som sätter ditt välmående i första rummet.
Stimulerande uppdrag: Du får jobba med spännande projekt hos stora företagskunder i komplexa integrationsmiljöer.
Möjlighet att växa i din karriär: Forma din roll i takt med att du utvecklas, och lär av branschens främsta experter inom integration.
Trygga förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig ersättning, utbildningsmöjligheter och certifieringar som hjälper dig att lyckas.
En organisation med ett tydligt syfte: Bli en del av ett bolag som är dedikerat till att skapa en mer rättvis värld genom att använda data och teknik på ett ansvarsfullt sätt.

Praktisk information

Alla roller på Epical är tillsvidareanställningar, med flexibilitet att arbeta hemifrån eller från något av våra kontor runt om i Sverige (Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Västerås, Örebro och Skövde). För att kvalificera dig behöver du vara bosatt i Sverige och ha giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Observera att säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslagen kan krävas för vissa uppdrag.

Låter det här som möjligheten du har väntat på? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Engineering Manager till Hogia Redovisning & Revision
jobs.description:
Är du en tekniskt stark ledare som drivs av att utveckla både människor och teknik? Vill du leda ett kompetent utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du driver den tekniska utvecklingen mot moderna, molnbaserade lösningar? Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.
Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.
Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML.
Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.
Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.
Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.
Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi kommer börja kontakta intressanta kandidat i mitten av augusti. Under semesterperioden har vi begränsade möjligheter att besvara frågor.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.
Vi på Hogia utvecklar och levererar branschspecifika, verksamhetsstödjande system. Vi har mängder av affärskritiska branschanpassade system som underlättar livet, för att inte tala om lösningar inom ekonomi, lön/HR som passar alla, oavsett bransch.
Vi är experter på att göra administrativa och operativa processer enklare, effektivare och faktiskt lite roligare.
Välkommen till en hel värld av smarta branschlösningar!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.

We’re now looking for an AI Engineer
to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will work directly with customers to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that solve real business problems. You’ll combine broad engineering capability with hands-on delivery, moving fast from idea to working prototypes to production-ready value. This role is about creative engineering, co-creation with users, and shaping how enterprises adopt AI in practice. You will also be part of Norrin’s AI Guild, a community where knowledge is shared, skills are developed together, and people actively support each other’s growth.

In this role, you will

Work closely with customers to understand their problems and rapidly design practical AI solutions
Implement end-to-end AI/ML workflows, from agents and RAG setups to traditional ML where needed
Build and deploy cloud-native applications, preferably on Azure
Apply modern software engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, quality-oriented development)
Use MLOps approaches to operationalize models, monitor them, and ensure they deliver value
Integrate with APIs and enterprise systems (REST, events, custom interfaces)
Work with databases, SQL, and pragmatic data engineering where required
Navigate between solution shaping, hands-on implementation, and light advisory, depending on the customer phase

What We’re Looking For

4+ years of experience in software or data applications, ideally with hands-on AI/ML components
Experience with AI agents and large language models (LLMs)
Strong cloud development background (Azure preferred)
Strong skills in Python and modern engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, testing mindset)
Experience with deploying and operating ML systems in production
Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, databases, and SQL
Ability to frame problems, design pragmatic solutions, and work directly with end-users
Strong English and Swedish skills (written & spoken)
Educational background in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or similar

Nice to have

Experience with IaC and containerization (Terraform, Docker)
Familiarity with PyTorch, LangChain/LlamaIndex, deep learning, and LLM evaluation frameworks
Experience working with data platforms (Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, event streams, data warehouses)
Background in structured testing approaches to ensure robustness
Prior consulting or customer-facing engineering experience
Prior leadership or consulting experience, with the ability to guide teams and advise stakeholders

Why Norrin? 

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges
keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer wellbeing benefits
like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our competitive compensation model
offers a fixed salary model or a hybrid model including base salary and a performance-based bonus.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

De flesta organisationer ser idag att data och AI är avgörande för framtida konkurrenskraft. Utmaningen är att veta var man ska börja och hur man skapar rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas över tid.

Våra kunder står inför strategiska beslut kring plattformar, arkitektur, styrning och AI-adoption. De beslut som fattas idag kommer att påverka deras förmåga att utveckla verksamheten, skapa innovation och dra nytta av data under många år framöver. 

Att fatta rätt beslut från början är avgörande. Fel arkitektur kan bromsa utveckling, öka kostnader och begränsa möjligheten att skapa värde från investeringar i data och AI. 

Som Data & AI Architect på Nexer Insight hjälper du kunder att navigera dessa beslut genom att definiera framtida arkitekturer, vägleda teknikval och forma strategiska transformationsinitiativ. 

Du kommer att påverka både teknikstrategi, affärsprioriteringar och långsiktig kundframgång samtidigt som du hjälper organisationer att bygga grunden för en datadriven framtid. 

Utmaningar du kommer att arbeta med: 

Modernisera äldre data- och analysmiljöer 
Definiera framtida arkitekturer 
Etablera skalbara och säkra plattformar 
Säkerställa att teknikinvesteringar stödjer affärsmålen 
Skapa de förutsättningar som krävs för AI-adoption

Ta fram strategier för data, analys och AI

Med rötter i svensk entreprenörsanda och innovation har vi hjälpt kunder att ligga steget före sedan internets början – i allt från strategi till teknik och kommunikation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must
be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve. To give some examples:

Distributed systems (e.g., intermittent connectivity and byzantine actors)
Embedded computing (e.g., resource-constrained compute and reverse-engineering)
Robotics (e.g., control systems and tasking)
Networking (e.g., long-range low-bandwidth radios and cross-medium routing)
Deployment infrastructure (e.g., air-gapped devices and heterogenous fleets)
Security (e.g., data sharing in low-trust, no-TLS networks and actually-secret data handling)
Machine learning (e.g., systems for model development, storage, and dissemination)

In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.

The day-to-day

Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work.
Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one.
Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation.
Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller “let’s learn together” groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time.
Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind.
Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirrelling away at something that doesn’t matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.

You should apply if you

Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code.
Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing.
Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming.
Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email).
Have backend development experience, ideally with a language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow.
Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time.
Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of engineering.

Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to have

Rust and Python specifically.
Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
Metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
SQL and streaming database systems.
Routing protocols (e.g., IGP, BGP).
Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
Robotics (e.g., control systems).
Production ML systems.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.

What We Offer

A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
Competitive compensation and VSOP options
Relocation support
Social and education allowances
Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Vi kombinerar spetskompetens inom IT med en kultur där det finns utrymme för både nyfikenhet och lekfullhet. Hos oss får du bidra med din expertis, växa i din roll och utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor som värdesätter samarbete högt.

Därför söker vi nu en Backend Developer som vill vara med och skapa framtidens lösningar tillsammans med oss. 🚀

Såhär kommer du att bidra

Som senior backendutvecklare på HiQ blir du en viktig pusselbit i konsultuppdrag som sträcker sig över olika branscher – från fordon och medtech till offentlig sektor och finans. Vissa uppdrag handlar om att bygga helt nya plattformar från grunden och andra om att vidareutveckla och optimera befintliga system.

Du kommer att:

Skapa och förvalta robusta, skalbara och säkra backendlösningar.
Jobba nära kollegor inom bland annat arkitektur, frontend, test och UX för att skapa helhetslösningar.
Få möjlighet att utforska olika branscher och bolag, samt testa på olika tekniker.
Dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra.
Vara med i tekniska diskussioner och bidra till hur både kunden och vi på HiQ kan bli ännu bättre.

Matchar vi?

Vi letar efter en utvecklare med minst 7 års erfarenhet inom backendutveckling, som gillar att grotta ner sig i kod men också att se den större bilden. Du har erfarenhet av flera eller några av dessa tekniker:

C# (.NET, ASP.NET, .NET Core)
C++ (Linux)
Python/Golang (Django, Flask)

För att skapa system som är skalbara, säkra och hållbara över tid krävs att du har erfarenhet och kunskap inom Cloudteknologier som Azure, AWS eller GCP. ☁️

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, flexibel och kommunikativ. Du uppskattar gemenskapen i ett team, men kan också ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du är flytande i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

Är du vår nästa HiQare?

I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Om du vill bygga framtidens digitala lösningar, utveckla din kompetens och samtidigt vara en del av ett gäng som tror att skratt, kaffe och kreativitet går hand i hand – då vill vi höra från dig! 🤝

👉 Skicka in din ansökan idag och bli en del av HiQ-gemenskapen!

Sist men inte minst!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla - oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv till bordet. Hoppas vi hörs snart!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101130

Help Shape How Cities Are Designed

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us in developing the next generation of our AI-powered architecture design platform. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the quality and capability of our product. You'll work on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.

Your work will enable architects, planners, and developers to discover smarter, more sustainable solutions and gain meaningful insights into their projects.

About Us

We’re on a mission to help design better cities.

With 90% of future population growth expected in urban areas, and construction responsible for around 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. Our cloud-based Autodesk Forma platform helps users evaluate design choices based on environmental impact, living quality (sun, daylight, noise), and project feasibility. We started as Spacemaker in Norway and became part of Autodesk in 2020.

Learn more about Autodesk Forma here.

How We Work

We work in small, autonomous teams with a high degree of trust and ownership. We strongly believe in servant leadership and team accountability. In each team, software engineers work closely together with product managers and designers. To learn more about our way of working, read through our tech and product core beliefs.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will deliver high-quality work and contribute to technical decisions within your team, while increasing your impact through ownership of complex features and systems.

In This Role, You Will

Contribute to technical direction within your team and provide input on architectural decisions
Take ownership of complex features and systems, driving their design and delivery end-to-end
Contribute to technical planning within your team and help align work with product goals
Navigate trade-offs between performance, cost, and user experience in complex workflows
Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver meaningful user outcomes
Share knowledge and support the growth of your teammates

Desired profile

Works independently on complex problems and navigates ambiguity within your domain
Takes ownership of technical decisions within your team and contributes to broader architectural conversations
Strong expertise in your primary domain with growing breadth across related technologies
Collaborates effectively and helps teammates grow
Proactively identifies and acts on improvements within your scope
Collaborates across functions to align engineering with product and user outcomes
Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes at scale

Areas of expertise that might resonate with you

You get your energy from building the foundations other people rely on, pulling systems apart into simple, observable pieces, owning something in production long enough to feel responsible for it, and reaching for the boring, reliable option before building something new.
You're drawn to problems where the math is the hard part, geometry, simulation, optimization, and you like taking a model from "this is the theory" to something that runs reliably on real inputs and matches what users expect to see.
You start from the user and the problem, not the ticket. You are comfortable with a fuzzy brief and a blank repo, shipping fast to learn, and shaping what gets built as much as how it gets built.

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and seniority levels
Experience with Agentic AI

You might also bring

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser
Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models

Why join us

Work on real-world problems with measurable environmental impact
Shape technical direction at a platform level
Collaborate with experienced engineers across disciplines
Competitive compensation, pension, and benefits

We believe diverse teams build better products, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people can be themselves and do their best work. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement listed. Curiosity, empathy, and a growth mindset matter just as much to us.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment

Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits

We’re a Nordic team of highly motivated developers who are passionate about serving customers with timely, personalized communications to help them live a worry-free life and insure what is most dear to them. We work closely with business stakeholders to make this happen and value common Agile DevOps principles with CI/CD so we can continuously deploy value to clients.

We promote continuous tech nurturing, certifications and learning including hackathons both within our team and together with our partners at Microsoft, Bloomreach and Google. We love experimentation and constantly follow new technology to create better solutions.

Who are you?

You’re passionate about solution development in Azure
and have a solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming
using .NET
and C#
.

You Bring

Strong experience with .NET, C#, and Object-Oriented Programming
Experience developing solutions in Azure Cloud

Solid knowledge of Azure data storage (SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Storage)
Awareness of Information security and protecting our customers’ integrity (GDPR)
Bonus: Experience with React for UI development

You Also Have

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC.

We are now looking for a Integration Engineer
to strengthen our team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain integration solutions that connect cloud services, enterprise systems, and business-critical applications. You will work closely with customers and internal delivery teams to ensure integrations are reliable, secure, and scalable.

The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for contributing to and shaping integration architectures that support long-term business needs. You will take an active role across the full lifecycle of integration projects, from solution design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will

Design and implement API based and event driven integration solutions
Design integration solutions following Azure best practices and cloud native patterns
Build integrations using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
Develop and maintain integrations using C# and the .NET ecosystem
Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using tools such as Terraform
Ensure secure authentication, authorization, and API security using OAuth and best practices
Collaborate with architects, developers, and customers to design end to end integration solutions
Support deployments, monitoring, and continuous improvement of integration platforms, ensuring reliability and observability in production environments

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in API and integration development
Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
Hands on experience with Infrastructure as Code (tools such as Terraform)
Good understanding of OAuth authentication and API security best practices
Ability to take ownership of integration solutions and make technical decisions in customer projects
Experience with C# programming and the .NET ecosystem, particularly when building Azure Functions or custom integration components
Fluency in both Finnish and English
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Nice to have

Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Expertise in BizTalk
Previous experience delivering or managing integrations in large organizations
Broader data engineering development experience to contribute to both integration and data projects

Why Norrin?

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with Nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges
keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities
where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you.

We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
As a member of the Women in Tech network, we're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we offer comprehensive benefits
, including extensive occupational healthcare and dental care, insurance coverage, regular massages, and culture and sports benefits. Our compensation model includes a competitive base salary, a performance-based bonus
, and the opportunity to participate in an employee fund.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

jobs.title: Senior Developer (teknisen arkkitehdin urapolku), Power Platform & Dynamics 365
jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut ohjelmistokehittäjä, joka on huomannut käyttävänsä yhä enemmän aikaa teknisten ratkaisujen suunnitteluun, arkkitehtuurin hahmottamiseen tai muiden kehittäjien sparraamiseen?

Haemme
Digian Customer Applications & Power Platform (CA&PP) -yksikköön osaajaa, joka haluaa ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallaan kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis arkkitehti, mutta toivomme, että sinulla on jo kokemusta teknisistä päätöksistä, ratkaisujen suunnittelusta sekä kokonaisuuksien hahmottamisesta.

CA&PP-yksikössämme työskentelee yli 80 Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -osaajaa. Meitä yhdistää vahva asiantuntijuus, auttamisen kulttuuri sekä halu rakentaa asiakkaille aidosti lisäarvoa tuottavia ratkaisuja.

Työskentelemme hybridimallilla ja se tarkoittaa meille sitä, että digialaisilla on vapaus valita työskentelypaikkansa viitenä päivänä viikossa työn ja työyhteisön tarpeet huomioiden.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön kehitystyö ja kasvava vastuu teknisestä suunnittelusta.

Pääset esimerkiksi:

suunnittelemaan Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -ratkaisujen teknisiä toteutuksia
osallistumaan arkkitehtuurien, integraatioiden ja ratkaisukokonaisuuksien mallintamiseen
Rakentamaan tekoälyratkaisuja asiakkaille
sparraamaan kehittäjiä teknisissä ratkaisuissa
tekemään edelleen hands-on-kehitystä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan
osallistumaan asiakaskeskusteluihin ja teknisten vaihtoehtojen arviointiin
vaikuttamaan siihen, miten ratkaisuja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa
seuraamaan Microsoft-ekosysteemin kehitystä ja tuomaan uusia mahdollisuuksia osaksi asiakasratkaisuja

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla pitkäaikaista kokemusta arkkitehtina. Sen sijaan arvostamme kokemusta ja kiinnostusta tekniseen suunnitteluun.

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta ainakin osasta seuraavista:

Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Dynamics 365 -ratkaisuista
JavaScriptista ja/tai C#:sta (esimerkiksi pluginit)
integraatioista ja Azure-palveluista
DevOps- ja ALM-käytännöistä
teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, dokumentoinnista tai arkkitehtuurikuvausten laatimisesta
tekoälytyökalujen hyödyntämisestä omassa työssä
muiden kehittäjien tukemisesta tai teknisestä ohjaamisesta

Työssä tarvitset hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Tämä rooli sopii erinomaisesti sinulle, joka haluat kasvaa kohti teknistä arkkitehtuuria kokeneiden ammattilaisten ympäröimänä.

Tarjoamme:

mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa polkuasi senior developerista kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia.
Oppimista tukevan kulttuurin. Sinulle varataan viikoittain aikaa uuden oppimisen ja teknologioihin syventymiseen eli työarjessasi on väljyyttä.
Mentorointia ja tukea kokeneilta arkkitehdeilta ja kehittäjiltä. Myös toimitustiimien ja heimojen kautta osaamista jaetaan työajalla.
Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa roolisi sisältöön ja urapolkuusi.
Erinomaiset työsuhde-edut, kuten kattavat työterveyspalvelut, loma-ajan mökit, 2000 euron rekrytointibonuksen jne.
OpenClub-yhteisöt: leffat, padel, käsityöt, lautapelit, kahvihifistely, viinit, uinti… löydät varmasti omasi!

Räätälöimme lopullisen roolin osaamisesi, kokemuksesi ja uratoiveidesi mukaan.

Hakuaika päättyy 11.10.2026.
