jobs.description:
Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business.
This is an initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.

The Impact
– Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering:
Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership

🏆 Global recognition:
Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges:
Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year-on-year, with over 11,000 e-motorbikes financed and demand climbing

🌱 Real climate impact:
Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event-driven microservices with real-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end-to-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting-edge .NET development with purpose-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

Technical Environment 💻

Languages & frameworks: C#/.NET
Cloud: We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
Architecture: Event-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana
Engineering culture: DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery
AI tooling: We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

High quality output
Observability and monitoring
Automated testing in all environments, including production
Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

What You Need

We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development.

Required Experience:

Strong grasp of C# .NET development
Experience with event-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Microservices architecture experience
Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP
Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Testing and deployment expertise
DevOps culture mindset
Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

Location & Benefits

Initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role
Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones
Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍
We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model, with M-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Connected 📱: 6 million smartphone customers, 2.5 million first-time smartphone users
Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents
Green 🌱: 11,000+ e-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year-on-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

Ready to build C# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern backend engineering?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritise well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Apply now to join our mission of transforming lives across Africa through technology.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com
.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Cakewalk

Cakewalk is access management for the entire workforce: AI agents and human identities. We built a single platform to govern and secure access in companies through policy-first access management, runtime provisioning, and identity-linked lifecycles.

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our ambitious engineering team and help accelerate our product development.

You will join a team of 10 engineers as a senior individual contributor, reporting to an Engineering Manager. This role is for someone who combines technical strength, grit, and self-reflection, and who is excited to take meaningful ownership in a fast-moving environment.

About the Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will build and improve customer-facing functionality across our frontend and backend. You will own features from early product discussions through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing maintenance.

You will collaborate closely with Product and Customer Success to understand customer needs and turn them into reliable, maintainable solutions. You will also help us improve and expand our AI-augmented engineering workflows while remaining fully accountable for the quality, security, and architecture of the resulting code.

The approximate focus of the role is:
45% backend engineering
25% frontend engineering
20% AI tooling and agentic engineering workflows
10% infrastructure and platform engineering

What You’ll Do

Build and own product functionality
Design, build, test, and release new frontend and backend features.
Take end-to-end ownership of your work, including technical design, implementation, testing, documentation, deployment, and maintenance.
Make sound architectural decisions around design patterns, reusable components, APIs, data models, and system boundaries.
Help expand a product that governs access for both human users and AI agents.

Contribute to product development
Collaborate with Product during the early stages of feature design.
Provide both technical and functional input on proposed solutions.
Work closely with Customer Success to understand customer needs and implementation challenges.
Translate customer and product requirements into reliable technical solutions.

Advance AI-augmented engineering
Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable IDE-integrated agents to build, test, document, and review software.
Work with our existing agentic engineering workflows and help improve and expand them.
Create and maintain reusable agent skills, contextual instructions, and related patterns that accelerate development and promote architectural consistency.
Standardize the context provided to coding agents through approaches such as AGENTS.md, skills, and similar mechanisms.
Maintain strict human-in-the-loop accountability for code quality, security, and architectural decisions.
Act as the final reviewer of AI-generated output and ensure that it meets our engineering standards.

Maintain a high quality bar
Write clean, reliable, secure, and maintainable code.
Apply effective testing practices.
Review code critically, regardless of whether it was written by a human or generated with AI assistance.
Treat bugs as an immediate priority. We do not knowingly leave defects in the platform: when we identify a bug, we fix it.
Contribute to technical documentation and Architecture Decision Records.
Communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly across engineering and non-engineering teams.

What We Expect

You should have:
At least four years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Engineer.
Strong professional experience building backend services and single-page web applications.
Strong experience with TypeScript, React, C# and .NET Core or closely comparable frontend technologies.
Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable development agents.
Experience managing or contributing to agentic development workflows.
A strong understanding of domain-driven design and experience applying it to production systems.
Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
A good understanding of HTTP, OAuth, OpenID Connect, encryption, and API security.
Experience making data-informed technical decisions and clearly explaining the reasoning and trade-offs behind them.
Experience writing technical documentation, including Architecture Decision Records.
Experience implementing integration testing strategies.
Experience working with component libraries or design systems such as Material UI, styled-components, or comparable technologies.
An understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, together with the analytical skills needed to verify and refine AI-generated solutions.
Fluent English and the ability to communicate comfortably with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Availability during our core collaboration hours of 10:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. CET.

A bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related subject is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

Prior experience in Identity and Access Management or cybersecurity is not required. However, we expect the security awareness and foundational understanding appropriate for a senior software engineer.

Our Technology

Our current technology stack includes:

Frontend
TypeScript
React
Material UI
TanStack Query

Backend
C#
.NET Core
PostgreSQL
Redis
RabbitMQ

Platform and observability
AWS
Kubernetes
Grafana
Sentry

Our system is organized around modular monoliths and domain-driven design. We value engineers who understand architectural trade-offs and can help the system evolve as the product and organization grow.

What Success Looks Like

In your first three months
You will:
Develop a solid understanding of our codebase and engineering practices.
Build a strong foundational understanding of the Identity and Access Management domain.
Release your first backend feature.
Release your first frontend feature.
Begin contributing effectively to product and technical discussions.

After 6–12 months
You will:
Operate autonomously as a senior individual contributor.
Collaborate directly with Product to understand customer needs.
Turn those needs into well-designed, reliable, and maintainable software.
Own features throughout their complete lifecycle.
Contribute meaningfully to the evolution of our architecture and engineering practices.
Improve and expand our AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.

Some of the challenges you may work on include integrations with different products, protocols, AI agents, Model Context Protocol servers, and other emerging technologies.

Our Principles

Put Simplicity First
Our reason for existing is to simplify IAM. We make our product intuitive and powerful, our customer interactions valuable, and our internal processes efficient. We support our coworkers to ensure our collective success.

Think Big. Iterate Fast. Reflect Openly.
We focus on what is possible, prioritize outcomes over busy activity, and work in short cycles. We value deep thinking, radical transparency, and root-cause analysis over blame.

Everyone Sells Cakewalk
We are a product-driven organization, but our North Star is commercial success. Everything we do is ultimately for our customers.

Enjoy the Baking
Building a company is a challenge. We are here to win, but also to enjoy the ride. We foster an environment of growth and collaboration with fantastic humans.

What You Can Expect

An environment where strong reasoning and execution matter more than titles.
A technically pragmatic team that challenges the status quo in security and cares deeply about both product and sales.
Colleagues who combine brilliance in their fields with grit and self-reflection.
Teammates who support one another so that everyone can contribute their best work.
Direct collaboration with Product and Customer Success throughout the development process.
Founders who take a genuine interest in their people, build long-term relationships, and support every Cakewalker’s professional and personal growth.

Interviewing at Cakewalk

During the interview process, we want to understand:
Whether you can drive meaningful technical impact.
How you approach challenging engineering problems.
How you make and communicate technical decisions.
Whether our culture and working style align with the environment in which you do your best work.
How you can grow professionally and personally at Cakewalk.
How AI has affected your engineering workflow and judgment.

We openly use AI in our engineering work, but we place a high value on genuine human interaction. Please do not use AI tools during live interview conversations. It is always better to acknowledge that you do not know something than to rely on AI for an immediate answer.

Be prepared to discuss engineering principles, design patterns, clean architecture, domain-driven design, testing strategies, API design, and API security. We will be interested in your decision-making process, how you solve problems, and how you write and review code.

When sharing examples from your experience, we recommend using the CARR model:
Context: What was the situation or problem?
Action: What did you do?
Results: What was the outcome?
Reflection: What did you learn, and how did you grow?

Humility drives learning. During the process, you may receive direct feedback. We value candidates who listen carefully, reflect openly, and apply what they learn.
Before interviewing, we encourage you to learn about Cakewalk, our product, and the Identity and Access Management industry. Think about what distinguishes our approach and how your experience could help us build the governance layer for a workforce made up of both humans and AI agents.

A Final Note

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and experiences. Studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed qualification.
If you are excited about Cakewalk and believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply and allow our team to assess your experience.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.

Mimics Flow is our innovative case management solution designed to streamline personalized patient care. By providing full visibility and control over every step of the workflow—from request to approval—Mimics Flow empowers surgeons and hospitals to deliver high-quality results while ensuring seamless compliance with local regulations.

As part of the Mimics Flow platform, you will play a key role in shaping the architecture of our new service, Mimics Workflow, a standalone product that integrates seamlessly into the platform. We are looking for a  Software Architect
 who combines technical expertise with strategic vision and exceptional communication skills to ensure the success of this new service and its alignment with our mission.

What You Will Do

Define and manage the architecture of one or more applications in the Mimics Flow platform.
Provide implementation strategies, work decomposition, and technology recommendations.
Serve as the technical and architectural point of contact for your team, sharing best practices and mentoring team members.
Collaborate with product management, stakeholders, and other teams to define and defend the technical roadmap.
Represent your team in the Materialise group of architects to align solutions across departments.
Maintain architecture documentation and contribute to cloud-related initiatives.
Actively participate in agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Your Profile

Technical Skills

You have experience with/working knowledge of: .NET Core, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, and Automapper. Designing modern cloud-native applications, including Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and DevOps practices. Cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related tools, such as Kubernetes, Docker, and Amazon Storage. Walking up the cloud stack (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) using modern terminology and relevance. Designing and developing integrations and interactions with other systems and applications.
You are familiar with networking technologies and DevOps tools related to software solution design, including REST, gRPC, GraphQL, and Terraform.
You are familiar with front-end technologies, such as TypeScript, NodeJS, and React.
Knowledge of BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) is a plus.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with product management, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
Confidence in negotiating and defending architectural decisions and technical roadmaps.
A proactive mentor who shares best practices and inspires the team toward technical excellence.

Mindset and Culture Fit

A strategic thinker with a helicopter view, capable of aligning technical solutions with business priorities and long-term goals.
Familiarity with agile working methods (Scrum, Kanban) and enthusiasm for contributing to a self-organizing team.
Passion for Materialise’s mission to scale additive manufacturing across industries, from aerospace to medical, and drive Industry 4.0.

What’s Waiting For You

Work that matters

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.

A people-centered space

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.

As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Join Preply’s Teams and help us power people’s progress through life-changing learning experiences. We’re on a mission to combine the magic of the best tutors with cutting-edge AI to create personalized journeys that keep learners motivated and inspired.

The Preply Engineering Team
provides the tools to help unlock human potential through learning. We implement A/B tests to prove the value of our initiatives and improve our product based on data and students' and tutors' feedback. As part of our commitment to ensuring high-quality products, we prioritize monitoring and metrics analysis to identify areas for optimization and ensure our services are performing at their best.

As a Senior II Backend Engineer,
you'll drive technical direction across multiple squads, lead high-impact initiatives, and build the systems that power Preply's global growth engine. Your work will influence how we scale our platform, align teams around shared outcomes, and help millions of learners connect with tutors worldwide.

Python is our primary language, but prior experience with it isn't mandatory. We take a tech-agnostic approach and welcome engineers from various backgrounds, such as Java, Node.js, Ruby, Scala, .NET, PHP, or Go. What we truly look for is an eagerness to learn the language and the adaptability to hit the ground running with product development.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own, shape, and drive technical direction across multiple engineering squads.
Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from idea to delivery, aligning engineers, teams, product managers, and stakeholders around shared outcomes.
Design, build, and evolve scalable backend systems using Python/Django, data pipelines, and third-party integrations that support long-term business growth.

Proven experience leading complex, greenfield projects end-to-end

Comfort with shaping product scope, challenging requirements, and focusing on customer value.
Strong communication (English level B2+) with the ability to influence senior peers and leadership through clear reasoning and strong technical judgment.

Willingness to join your team's on-call rotation (1 week out of every 5).

Why you’ll love it at Preply

Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Cloudflare Network Interconnect
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin, TX | London, UK | Lisbon, Portugal

About The Role

The CNI team builds and operates the systems that let Cloudflare's enterprise customers connect their networks directly to Cloudflare through private, dedicated interconnects — rather than traversing the public Internet. The product, Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), supports various interconnect types across hundreds of locations worldwide. These systems underpin Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Zero Trust, and application security for some of Cloudflare's largest customers.

What You'll Do

As a member of the team you will build and extend the systems that provision, monitor, and orchestrate private network interconnects at scale. You will collaborate with Product Management, Network Engineering, and Infrastructure teams on ambitious initiatives to connect enterprise customers directly to Cloudflare's global network.

Responsibilities

You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle: from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, Kubernetes, Linux networking, network operating systems, and BGP routing, among others.

Our team at Cloudflare operates under a "Run What You Build" model. This means we are responsible for the health of our systems and actively participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of our operational duties.

Because you'll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

Systems-level programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++.
Understanding of IP networking fundamentals: BGP, Layer 3 routing, and how physical and virtual interconnect technologies work (cross-connects, VLANs, overlay tunnels).
Experience building, deploying, and debugging distributed systems.
Experience participating in an on-call rotation for services with direct customer impact.
Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your workflow.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.

Bonus Points

Hands-on experience with BGP configuration, route policy, or peering operations.
Experience building provisioning or automation systems for network infrastructure.
Familiarity with network inventory and IPAM systems (e.g., NetBox).
Experience with cloud provider networking (AWS Direct Connect, GCP Partner Interconnect, Azure ExpressRoute).
Knowledge of GRE, VXLAN, or other overlay/tunnel technologies.
Experience with Kubernetes-based service deployments and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with telemetry/observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch).
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code completion, codebase analysis, log/data exploration) in a professional setting.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, PLM & Quality
jobs.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

What You’ll Be Part Of

As a Systems Engineer, you will design, build, and own applications and integrations that improve efficiency and effectiveness of the Business Systems in Automotive. The systems you build and work with will solve major business challenges with a focus on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) & Quality Systems at Harman.

The role is not transactional and not focused on only building and delivering code. It is focused on building Business Solutions based on real Problem Statements with freedom to create fit-for-purpose applications.

You are expected and encouraged to stay on with the latest and greatest technological trends to create value in your designs and in the business application.

This role is well‑suited for an experienced full‑stack software engineer, who is interested in applying Software Engineering and UX Design principles in a low‑code, model‑driven environment and thriving in creating applications with excellent user interfaces.

You will work on business‑critical systems that integrate with PLM, ERP, MES, and Quality platforms, enabling Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Program teams to manage complex product data in a controlled and traceable way. The problems you will solve are systemic, data‑intensive, and cross‑functional, rather than isolated feature development.

While low‑code platforms (e.g. Mendix for Apps, QLIK for Analytics) are part of the technology stack, this is not a configuration or scripting role. You will apply Object Oriented Programming concepts, data modelling, and architectural thinking to design maintainable, scalable solutions. Low‑code is used to accelerate delivery—not to replace engineering discipline.

In addition, you will leverage Analytics technologies (ex. QLIK) and Database technologies (ex Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, etc.) to build and create complete, well-rounded solutions in partnership with other HARMAN departments.

You will act as a technical owner within the Configuration Management domain, working closely with domain experts and HARMAN Digital IT to ensure that business requirements are implemented as robust, well‑designed systems.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Design and own the Business Architectures on a system / data model level for PLM & Quality
Translate complex business requirements into clear domain models, data structures, and system behavior.
Design and implement custom applications and services using: model driven development concepts, Low code platforms (e.g. Mendix) for rapid delivery of applications, Enterprise systems such as Teamcenter PLM and SAP
Design and Implement Analytics solutions, leveraging enterprise platforms (ex. QLIK with Snowflake)
Apply software engineering best practices, including modular design, encapsulation, reuse, and lifecycle management.
Define and maintain data models, interfaces, and integrations between PLM, Quality, ERP, and downstream systems.
Act as a technical counterpart to business stakeholders, ensuring solutions are scalable.
Analyze and resolve complex system, data, and process issues using structured root cause analysis.
Drive continuous improvement of Configuration and Change Management processes through system design rather than manual workarounds.
Support Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams in the effective use of CM related systems.
Build deep functional and technical expertise in assigned systems and contribute to migration and integration strategies as platforms evolve.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent professional experience) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
3-5 years of professional experience in software development, systems engineering, or enterprise application development.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and design principles
Proficiency in front end technologies (ex. React, HTML & CSS, JavaScript)
Strong Backend Development skills (ex. Node.js, python).
Experience with cloud platforms (ex. Azure)
Proficiency with Git and collaborative development technologies
Experience in system integrations and interfaces, example by using REST API and Microservices architecture
Proven ability to design end-to-end systems, including application logic, data structures, integrations, and building an application for scale.
Desire to learn and work with low-code and analytics platforms as part of a modern enterprise development ecosystem.
Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in written documentation and technical discussions.
Comfortable working in international, cross-functional teams, with a high level of ownership and accountability.

Bonus Points if You Have

AIAG Certification
Masters Degree
Experience with Agile Methodologies
Experience with Teamcenter, other PLM Applications, and enterprise systems
Experience with Low Code Platforms (ex. Siemens Mendix)
Experience with Database Technologies (SQL/NoSQL) and Data Lakes (ex. Snowflake, Databricks)
CMII Configuration Management certification (Certified or Professional)
Professional certification in change management / project management
Knowledge and application of continuous improvement philosophies

What Makes You Eligible

Be willing to travel up to 10%, domestic and international travel.
Be willing to work in the office and plant, in Székesfehérvár or Budapest.

What You Can Expect

A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
Tuition reimbursement support
Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

,

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

jobs.description:
We are seeking an elite, highly independent Principal Software Engineer & Architect who views advanced AI coding harnesses and multi-agent frameworks not as a crutch, but as a force multiplier for rapid, high-quality execution.

In this role, you will not be a cog in a massive machine, nor will you be stuck managing a single legacy codebase. Instead, you will act as a solo "special forces" engineer, moving dynamically from project to project. You will take loose, highly ambiguous business requirements and autonomously transform them into production-ready, enterprise-grade software. Your projects will span the entire functional spectrum—from building complex client portals to engineering mission-critical dispatch systems.

Because our applications deploy across a mix of Azure cloud and secure, on-premises environments, you must possess an uncompromising mindset regarding data sovereignty, rigid deployment constraints, and architectural security.

What You Will Do

Architect & Execute: Autonomously design, code, and deploy secure, scalable applications from scratch using C#/.NET and JavaScript/Node.js. You own the entire pipeline from blueprint to production.

Navigate Ambiguity: Translate vague, high-level business concepts into robust system architectures without requiring granular specifications or hand-holding.

Adapt and Pivot: Shift gears fluidly between rapid-prototyping greenfield sprints (2–4 weeks) and deep-dive enterprise deployments (3–6 months).

Own the Security Lifecycle: Ensure all codebases are rigorously hardened against the OWASP Top 10 and strictly adhere to secure, on-premises infrastructure requirements.

Orchestrate AI Workflows: Integrate your own preferred multi-agent frameworks and AI toolchains to accelerate development velocity, while maintaining absolute human oversight of logic, edge cases, and architectural integrity.

Who You Are

An Independent Thinker: You don't wait for a ticket to be fully groomed. You figure out what needs to be built, challenge assumptions when necessary, and deliver the right solution.

An AI Realist: You understand that AI is prone to hallucinations and lazy logic. You know how to orchestrate multi-agent workflows to handle the heavy lifting, but your own architectural expertise is what ensures the system is stable, secure, and performant.

A Full-Stack Enterprise Builder: You have deep, production-tested experience within both the Microsoft ecosystem (C#, .NET) and modern JavaScript/Node.js environments.

A Security-First Engineer: You have a proven track record of architecting for strictly controlled, hybrid, or on-prem environments where security cannot be an afterthought.

Requirements

7+ years of experience in enterprise-level software engineering and hands-on system architecture.

Mastery of C# / .NET and JavaScript / Node.js.

Strong experience designing hybrid architectures spanning Azure cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

Deep, practical understanding of OWASP Top 10 principles and secure coding practices.

Proven experience leveraging advanced AI coding assistants, custom multi-agent frameworks, or LLM-orchestrated workflows to significantly compress delivery timelines.

Exceptional ability to work entirely solo, owning projects from concept to deployment.

Why Join Us?

If you are tired of endless committee meetings, rigid corporate bureaucracy, and being locked into one mundane codebase for years, this is your playground. You will have the autonomy to choose your own AI workflow toolchain, the freedom of a fully remote position, and the challenge of building entirely different enterprise systems from scratch back-to-back.

new_jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren .NET-developer die de stap naar architectuur heeft gemaakt en zich de afgelopen jaren actief is gaan verdiepen in AI. Iemand met een stevige basis in C#/.NET, die weet wat er nodig is om software in productie te krijgen en te houden, en die zijn technische kennis en nieuwsgierigheid naar AI nu wil inzetten om het totaalontwerp van AI-oplossingen naar zich toe te trekken.

Concreet: samen met onze andere senior engineers bepaal je welke modellen en infrastructuur we inzetten, hoe die aansluiten op de bestaande systemen van ons en onze klanten, en je bouwt zelf mee om het werkend te krijgen. We zoeken nadrukkelijk geen AI-specialist zonder developmentachtergrond, en ook geen developer zonder affiniteit met AI. We zoeken de combinatie: een doorgewinterde .NET-engineer die het pad naar AI is ingeslagen.

Groeien met Hoppinger

We zijn eerlijk over waar we staan. Hoppinger is op dit moment nog geen AI-native organisatie. Onze platformen voor bedrijfskritische processen in zorg, housing, kennis en onderwijs en industrie zijn gebouwd op een stevige softwarebasis, met C#/.NET als belangrijk fundament. AI voegen we daar gericht aan toe.
De ambitie is wel duidelijk: we groeien naar een AI-first manier van werken, waarbij AI geen losstaand experiment is, maar een beheersbaar en schaalbaar onderdeel van het platform. Om die stap te zetten hebben we mensen nodig die hun technische ervaring en hun nieuwsgierigheid naar AI al effectief combineren in de praktijk. Jij helpt die transformatie waarmaken en geeft er mede richting aan.

Jouw rol: van bedrijfsprobleem naar werkende oplossing

Je vertaalt het vraagstuk van onze klanten naar een technische oplossing en bepaalt hoe AI wordt ingezet binnen hun platformen. Dat is breder dan modellen kiezen: het gaat om het ontwerpen van een complete oplossing, van architectuur tot productie. Je staat met één been in de code en met het andere aan het whiteboard bij de directie van onze klanten.
Je dagen zijn afwisselend en bestaan onder andere uit:
Het vertalen van een bedrijfsprobleem naar een technische architectuur
Het beoordelen welke AI-aanpak past: agents, klassieke ML of een combinatie, en de afweging tussen bouwen, kopen of een API aanroepen
Het zelf meebouwen aan oplossingen, in een omgeving waar C#/.NET en moderne frameworks de basis van onze platformen vormen
Het bewaken van non-functionals: schaalbaarheid, latency, kosten, beveiliging en compliance
Het werken aan agentic systemen: orkestratie, tool use, human-in-the-loop patronen en meer
Het samenwerken met experience architects, engineers en data-analisten, en het leiden van zowel een architectuurreview met developers als een whiteboard-sessie met een directeur

Wie ben jij

Je bent in de eerste plaats een ervaren software engineer met een sterke .NET-achtergrond, doorgegroeid naar een architectuurrol. Je hebt aantoonbaar software gebouwd en live gebracht, en je verdiept je actief in wat er nodig is om AI betrouwbaar in productie te draaien. Die laatste stap heb je al gezet of je bent er serieus mee bezig.
Je herkent jezelf hierin:
Ruime ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met C#/.NET als vaste waarde in je gereedschapskist. Dit is voor deze rol een harde eis, geen pré
Kennis van softwarearchitectuur: API-design, microservices, event-driven architectuur en containerisatie
Ervaring met minstens één hyperscaler (Azure, AWS of Google Cloud)
Hands-on ervaring met LLM's en het bouwen van AI-toepassingen. Productie-ervaring is een pré, een aantoonbare en al actieve drive om hierin verder te groeien is een eis
Affiniteit met agentic development en de ambitie om je hierin te specialiseren
Het vermogen om technische keuzes uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders, van product owner tot C-level
Relevante certificeringen (zoals Azure Solutions Architect of AWS Solutions Architect) zijn een pré, aantoonbare kennis en ervaring wegen zwaarder

Wat bieden wij

Veel vrijheid en een ambitieuze cultuur waar persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staat. Natuurlijk draait niet alles om werk, en bovenop alle gebruikelijke benefits die je mag verwachten bieden we ook:

new_jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Hybride
new_jobs.description:
Wil jij eigenaar zijn van een platform dat er echt toe doet? Van cloudinfrastructuur en releases tot een vloot slimme kasten in het veld, en van security-audits van veeleisende klanten tot de storing die niemand anders kan vinden? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wij zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die de dagelijkse werking van ons platform draagt: de Azure-infrastructuur, het uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen, CI/CD en releases, security en compliance, kostenbeheersing en de sleutelkasten en lockers die bij onze klanten draaien. Je bent de specialist op wie het team en onze klanten kunnen bouwen. Je adviseert onze Chief Software Officer over de technische keuzes en begeleidt junior en medior DevOps engineers in hun ontwikkeling.
Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior DevOps Engineer zorg jij dat wat het softwareteam bouwt betrouwbaar, veilig en herhaalbaar in productie komt en daar blijft draaien. Je ondersteunt de CSO bij strategische keuzes over architectuur en investeringen door te komen met onderbouwde voorstellen, die je uitvoert en bewaakt. Je werkt nauw samen met de Tech Lead en het softwareteam en bent het technische gezicht van Nauta Connect richting de IT- en securityafdelingen van onze klanten.
Platform en netwerk:
je beheert en ontwikkelt onze cloud- en on-premise infrastructuur via Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/deployment stacks/Azure Verified Modules), firewalls, loadbalancers, Front Door, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Services, ExpressRoute en VPN, DNS en certificaten.
Uitrol nieuwe klanten:
je zet de infrastructuur voor nieuwe klanten en omgevingen geautomatiseerd en volgens de standaard neer (spoke, netwerk, database, toegang en configuratie), ontwikkelt die standaard door en faseert omgevingen gecontroleerd uit.
Releases en pipelines:
je onderhoudt en verbetert onze CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps (smoke- en performancetests, quality gates, security scanning, geautomatiseerde databasemigraties) en voert de releases en hotfixes van onze productsuite uit, met minimale downtime via blue/green of canary deployments.
Security en compliance:
je werkt shift-left: je signaleert en dicht kwetsbaarheden met tooling als SonarQube, GitLeaks, OWASP Dependency-Check, Trivy en OWASP ZAP, stelt securityrapportages op, beantwoordt security-vragenlijsten van klanten en ondersteunt onze ISO 27001-audits.
Databases en observability:
je beheert onze SQL Server- en PostgreSQL-databases in productie (backups, herstel, migraties, performance) en richt monitoring in met Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics en Grafana.
Kosten:
je maakt de kosten van het platform per omgeving en per klant inzichtelijk, optimaliseert zonder verlies van beschikbaarheid of veiligheid en maakt de kostenimpact van elk voorstel expliciet.
Vloot en devices:
je bouwt en onderhoudt de Linux golden image voor onze kasten en lockers en beheert de vloot in het veld: provisioning, updates en het oplossen van problemen op de devices.
Incidenten en klantomgevingen:
je bent het eindstation voor storingen die support en het softwareteam niet kunnen oplossen, ook op het grensvlak van software en infrastructuur. Je bouwt testopstellingen die klantomgevingen nabootsen en helpt klanten ons product veilig in hun netwerk te landen.
Team en kennis:
je leidt de junior en medior DevOps engineers op, reviewt infrastructuur- en securitywerk en zorgt dat kennis in het team wordt vastgelegd in plaats van in één hoofd.

Wat motiveert jou?

Eigenaarschap:
je bijdrage heeft een echte impact op ons platform.
Breedte:
cloud, netwerk, pipelines, security, databases, kosten, embedded devices en klantnetwerken; weinig DevOps-rollen zijn zo veelzijdig.
Impact:
klanten als zorginstellingen en overheden vertrouwen dagelijks op wat jij draaiende houdt.
Groei:
bij bewezen diepgang volg jij het ontwikkelpad naar DevOps Architect.
Samenwerking:
korte lijnen met de CSO en de Tech Lead, en DevOps-collega's die van jou willen leren.
Flexibiliteit:
hybride werken en werktijden die bij je passen.

Dit bieden wij jou

Een compact, divers en gedreven team waarin jouw werk direct zichtbaar is
Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van je ervaring, en fijne secundaire voorwaarden
Tijd en budget voor opleidingen, certificeringen en conferenties
Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken
Laptop en telefoon van de zaak en wat je nodig hebt om ook thuis prettig te werken
28 vakantiedagen
Korting op je sportschoolabonnement, een vitaliteitsprogramma met allerlei (sportieve) activiteiten en gezellige teamuitjes.
Een cultuur waarin experimenteren mag, fouten maken erbij hoort en successen samen gevierd worden

Wat breng jij mee?

Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in IT of informatica, of gelijkwaardige kennis opgebouwd in de praktijk.
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in DevOps of platform engineering, met aantoonbare verantwoordelijkheid voor productieomgevingen.
Diepgaande kennis van Microsoft Azure (onder meer App Services, Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, Front Door, Application Gateway, SignalR, Managed Redis) en van Azure-netwerken: landing zone, hub-and-spoke, VNet-peering, NSG's, private endpoints, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute en VPN.
Ruime ervaring met Infrastructure as Code met Bicep en/of Terraform, met containers (Docker, Container Apps, AKS) en met CI/CD in Azure DevOps Pipelines.
Ervaring met het geautomatiseerd uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen.
Ervaring met high-availability-ontwerpen en minimal-downtime-releases (blue/green, canary) en met incidentonderzoek op basis van logs, traces en databases.
Ervaring met DevSecOps-tooling, CVE-afhandeling en securityrapportages binnen ISO 27001, de OWASP Top 10 en de NCSC-richtlijnen.
Ervaring met SQL Server en PostgreSQL in productie, met monitoring en observability en met Linux inclusief golden images.
Scripting in Bash en PowerShell, en voldoende leesvaardigheid in .NET/C# om applicatiecode op infrastructuur- en securityaspecten te reviewen.
Het vermogen om complexe technische zaken helder uit te leggen aan klanten en collega's, in het Nederlands en Engels.
Een pré:
ervaring met ARM en Ansible, MariaDB en MySQL, fleetmanagement van embedded devices, Python en/of C#, andere cloudplatformen, of certificeringen op het gebied van Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform of security.

Wie zijn wij?

Nauta Connect ontwikkelt slimme oplossingen voor de uitgifte en het beheer van sleutels en bedrijfsmiddelen: elektronische sleutelkasten en lockers, naadloos geïntegreerd met onze eigen Connect-software. Die software is het kloppende hart van onze oplossingen en wordt volledig in huis ontwikkeld. Onze klanten zijn onder meer zorginstellingen, gemeentes, onderwijsinstellingen en organisaties met hoge eisen aan veiligheid en beschikbaarheid.

Ons softwareteam is compact, hecht en denkt actief mee. We gaan graag de uitdaging aan om complexe problemen binnen organisaties op te lossen, waarbij onze hardware en slimme software samen het verschil maken. Korte lijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de ruimte om iets écht te bouwen.

Nauta Connect is onderdeel van de Nauta Group, een (h)echt familiebedrijf met het hoofdkantoor in Barneveld. Hoe gaat het met je? En heb je nog leuke plannen voor de komende dagen? Het zijn vragen die je vaak hoort in onze wandelgangen. We houden van persoonlijk contact met elkaar en met onze klanten, en werken iedere dag met een enthousiast team van zo'n 170 medewerkers aan het succes van ons bedrijf.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management | Full-Stack
new_jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team
. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health
Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers
Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn
A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

You will sit at the intersection of our optimization engine and our customers: modeling real-world planning problems, and shipping working solutions fast, embedded with customer teams under tight deadlines.

This role suits an engineer who wants to solve hard optimization problems in the field, work directly with customers, and feed what they learn back into the core product.

Frontend: Angular, TypeScript

Customer scheduling and planning problems modeled accurately and solved within performance targets.
