new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack
new_jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Business Acceleration Track (BAT)
. This is the engine room of DeepL’s global growth. While our Research teams build the models, BAT builds the Revenue Flywheel
that allows 200,000+ Enterprises (like the Fortune 500) to actually use and pay for them at scale .

We are moving upmarket. We are transitioning from a consumer-focused app to a mission-critical Enterprise Platform. You will be part of the team architecting the "Financial Nervous System" of DeepL — handling everything from Identity & Access Management (SSO, SCIM) to complex multi-seat Subscription Architectures and Fraud Prevention .

We don't hire engineers to just implement UI tickets. We hire Missionaries
who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will own the full vertical: from the user-facing Admin Console in React to the distributed billing logic in C#/.NET.

Your Responsibilities

Architect Revenue-Critical Flows: You will design and ship complex, high-stakes features like "Enterprise Licensing" or "Automated Seat Provisioning." You ensure that when a customer upgrades, the UX is instant, and the billing ledger is immutable.
Own the "Enterprise Experience": You will build the tools that empower CIOs and IT Directors to manage DeepL. You translate complex backend constraints (RBAC, Rate Limits) into simple, elegant UI workflows.
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .
Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Software Engineering & Innovation Summer Internship 2027 (June - August)

A summer at Baillie Gifford could transform your career before it even starts. As an independent global investment management business, we rely on technology to underpin everything we do. That’s why we constantly invest in our technology and the team of professionals who bring it to life. Join us as a summer intern and show us what you can do!

What can you expect

You’ll be immersed in our technology environment from the word go on our paid summer internship. Expect to do real work and take responsibility as you gain hands-on experience with our technologies in an AI-native environment. You can look forward to being part of a refreshingly open, cooperative, and supportive team culture. Plus, you will get the training and support to broaden your skills and discover your future potential, from LinkedIn Learning, to Pluralsight and peer-to-peer working, a summer with us will transform your skillset and CV!

Interns will be placed into cohorts, working on different live technical projects aligned to either our Application Development and Enablement Department or our Innovation Department. While the projects and technologies used will vary, all cohorts will gain exposure to emerging technologies, including AI and large language models (LLMs), and will have opportunities to explore how these tools are applied across our technology teams. Which team and project our interns will land in will depend on business needs.

Our Software Engineers create scalable applications and solutions that drive our business and make it smarter for the future. We’ll introduce you to our modern programming languages, cloud platforms and DevOps practices and show you how software engineering shapes the future of investment management. You’ll have the opportunity to touch a wide range of tech, possibly including .NET, Angular, Azure Service Bus, Docker and Microservices Architecture, to name a few, as well as getting to grips with Agile methodologies in a business setting.

Within our R&D team, our Engineers push the boundaries of what is possible with disruptive tech and grapple with deeply interesting problems. They work with a broad range of technologies, including Python and platforms such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and Hugging Face, as well as Gen AI, LLMs, CI/CD, containerisation and cloud.

You’ll discover how technology drives the business forward in the fast-evolving investment management industry. Irrespective of which department you land in, you’ll be exposed to emerging tech and new ideas.

Your internship will start with structured overviews that introduce you to our business. Following induction, you and your fellow interns will work together within your cohort on a live technical project for the firm. We’ll ensure you spend quality time with our experienced technical and business leads, who will share their knowledge and support you throughout the process. You can expect to get hands-on with the latest tools and approaches in AI – from working with large language models to building agentic workflows and intelligent systems.

Intapp is looking for a Client Support Engineer to join our Client Success & Support team. This is a technical, client-facing role focused on the investigation and resolution of issues across Intapp Time — our time capture and management platform — in both cloud and on-premise environments.

What you'll do

Investigate common support scenarios such as time-entry and submission failures, missing client or matter data, validation and synchronisation issues, performance problems, login failures, and integration errors.

Use logs, error messages, configuration, browser diagnostics, API responses, and client-provided evidence to isolate root cause and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, network, or environmental issues.

Troubleshoot integrations between Intapp Time and clients' practice-management or financial-management systems using SQL, stored procedures, SOAP/REST APIs, data mappings, service accounts, and integration logs.

Support issues involving Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi) and Intapp Integrate, including schedules, connectors, mappings, credentials, queues, and process reporting.

Apply impact-based triage and prioritisation, taking account of production availability, affected users, business impact, and service-level expectations, and act promptly on high-priority or widespread issues.

Provide accurate, timely, and technically clear updates to client contacts, translating complex findings into practical next steps and maintaining ownership through to resolution.

Prepare complete escalation packages for product defects, including business impact, diagnostic evidence, steps to reproduce, and relevant logs.

Recognise when a request falls outside break-fix support and route it to the appropriate team while maintaining a smooth client handover.

Maintain accurate, audit-ready ticket records and contribute to knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides that improve consistency and time to resolution.

What you'll need

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Experience supporting integrations between enterprise business applications.

Practical experience with ticketing systems and support workflows, including impact-based prioritisation, SLA management, and accurate technical documentation.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex symptoms, interpret logs, and identify root cause.

Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL experience is highly desirable.

Working knowledge of SOAP and REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, JSON/XML payloads, and common integration or connectivity issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical client contacts.

A strong sense of ownership and client responsibility, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and exercise sound judgement on when to escalate.

A genuine interest in using AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of support work; hands-on experience applying AI in a support or technical environment is an advantage.

Desirable

Experience supporting Intapp Time, other Intapp Profitability products, Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi), or Intapp Integrate.

Experience integrating time or billing applications with legal practice-management or financial-management systems such as Aderant, Elite/3E, or Carpe Diem.

Understanding of synchronisation, data mapping, scheduled jobs, and source-of-truth concepts in integrated enterprise applications.

Familiarity with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, PowerShell, or SQL Server, or relevant Microsoft, .NET, or SQL certification.

Experience with enterprise connectivity troubleshooting, including DNS, proxies, TLS certificates, firewall rules, load balancers, or network tracing tools such as Wireshark or Fiddler.

Experience with identity and access technologies such as SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or Microsoft Entra ID.

Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or browser developer tools.

Experience creating knowledge-base content or support procedures that reduce recurring issues and improve resolution quality.

What you'll gain

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible, where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities.

Expand your skills

Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

Enjoy where you work

Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energised throughout the day.

Support what matters most

Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time-off programmes and benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation-matching programme for the causes you care about.

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex symptoms, interpret logs, and identify root cause.

Familiarity with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, PowerShell, or SQL Server, or relevant Microsoft, .NET, or SQL certification.

Experience with identity and access technologies such as SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or Microsoft Entra ID.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to embed directly with customers on IFS PSO, our enterprise scheduling and optimization platform (.NET 10/C# backend, Angular frontend) used to solve complex resource planning and scheduling problems at scale. This is a hands-on technical role that combines software engineering, applied optimization and direct customer engagement.

You will sit at the intersection of our optimization engine and our customers: modeling real-world planning problems, and shipping working solutions fast, embedded with customer teams under tight deadlines.

This role suits an engineer who wants to solve hard optimization problems in the field, work directly with customers, and feed what they learn back into the core product.

We're AI-first: you'll be expected to make full use of AI-assisted and agentic workflows day to day, and we're looking for someone genuinely enthusiastic about using them to model problems and ship solutions faster.

Key Responsibilities

Partner directly with customers to translate real-world scheduling and planning problems into optimization models.
Configure, extend, and debug the core scheduling engine and related components against live customer datasets.
Build and iterate on new solutions with customer teams, often under tight deadlines.
Feed field learnings back to core product and engineering teams to improve the platform.

Qualifications

Strong software engineering background, ideally C#/.NET; comfortable reading and modifying a large codebase.
Hands-on experience with optimization techniques, constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, or algorithm development.
Comfortable working directly with customers: gathering requirements, explaining trade-offs, and presenting results.
Bias toward shipping, with a willingness to develop and iterate quickly under ambiguity.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous, real-world constraints.

Preferred / Bonus Experience

Experience with Angular/TypeScript or other modern frontend frameworks.
Background in workforce or resource scheduling domains.
Experience with large-scale data modelling.
Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms or vertical-specific optimization products.

Technology Stack (Representative)

Backend: .NET 10, C#
Frontend: Angular, TypeScript
Optimization: Constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, heuristics, algorithm development.
Deployment: On-site and embedded customer environments, cloud-hosted platform
Practices: Git, automated testing, DevOps

What Success Looks Like

Customer scheduling and planning problems modeled accurately and solved within performance targets.
Working solutions shipped to customers, on tight timelines.
Optimizer performance and quality issues diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
Field learnings translated into concrete product and engineering improvements.
Strong, trusted relationships built with customer teams.

Additional Information

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

new_jobs.description:
Location
: Rzeszów (remote/hybrid options available)
Salary
: 13-20K PLN gross per month – Umowa o Pracę
Job Type
: Full-Time, Permanent

Are you looking to make your mark in a developer-centric and technology-focused software company? NewOrbit are looking for skilful software engineers wanting to expand their experience and be a central part of our exciting and growing team.

About Us NewOrbit Poland is a sister company of NewOrbit, a successful, innovative UK-based business that has been delivering software for nearly 15 years. We are a skilled and close-knit team, who work together to deliver entirely bespoke, highly-scalable, cloud-hosted web applications for our clients. We collaborate with a wide variety of clients, which means you gain exposure to lots of different industries - and challenges to solve.
Our stack is typically React
, . NET
, and Azure SQL Server
or Cosmos DB
, but expect variations on that as NewOrbit host everything on Azure
using a wide range of the available technologies. We’re a Microsoft Solutions Partner
, working very closely with Microsoft, including on new Azure technologies before they are released to the general public.

Candidate Requirements Our ideal candidate is someone with breadth, including C#
, TypeScript
, HTML/CSS
, and SQL
. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them, but you do need some full-stack experience. Ideally, you’ll have had some exposure to distributed system design and the full life-cycle of software development.
You will be comfortable estimating and designing features, and communicating with others. For a more senior role, you’ll need experience in technical leadership. There’s no staff management required for this role, but if that’s your one of your career goals then we have opportunities for that too.
NewOrbit use Agile
software development methods, so you should understand these approaches. If you’ve done Scrum that’s ideal, but an Agile mindset is more important.
Although not essential for the role, some test automation experience (e.g. test architecture, CI/CD) would be advantageous.

Overview of Responsibilities Working as part of a small project team where everyone is involved in the planning and execution of work.
Producing clean code to agreed timescales and quality.
Owning features and delivering them with minimal supervision.
Reviewing and submitting pull requests.
Handing over features for acceptance testing.
Owning or contributing to technical design and architecture.

For more senior candidates you would also be:
Leading a small project team of developers, you would be working alongside a project manager and product owner, but still very ‘hands-on’ and in code day-to-day.
Mentoring other members of the development team.
Assessing new technologies and patterns.
Helping us to interview potential candidates for the team.

Why NewOrbit? Being part of NewOrbit is much more than just a salary and holiday allowance (although those are important too!). Your package will include the following benefits, so you can share in our success:
Hybrid and remote working options – expect to visit our offices occasionally, ideally weekly. But let us know if you need more — or less!
Profit share scheme (discretionary)
Private LuxMed healthcare
MultiSport card co-financing
A friendly environment full of fellow enthusiasts:
Meals out
Activity days & retreat weekends
Outdoor activities

Work with us to: Enjoy what you do
: We hire smart people who share our drive and are genuinely proud of our team. We do projects that we believe in and aren’t afraid to challenge clients (and say no). We get our work done and go home - there’s no late-night working culture here.
Grow your career
: Our supportive environment and clear career paths help you thrive. NewOrbit provide access to Pluralsight and Frontend Masters on-demand training and share knowledge within the team through tech talks & coding sessions. We can also provide you with time or learning resources to get Azure certified.
Stay interested
: We welcome innovation and stay at the forefront, actively encouraging side projects and experimentation. We provide you with monthly Azure credits that you can use for whatever you like.
Have an impact
: Our driver is to make a positive difference to our clients and the team, so we look for people who own problems and feel personal pride in what they do. We rely on everyone in the team to look outwards and help decide and drive our technical strategy. If you think there’s something we can do better, we’ll listen.

Application Process Interested?
Please send your CV and any useful links you might have (Stack Overflow, GitHub, open source projects) to recruitment@neworbit.pl.
The next step would be a short 10-15 minute telephone call to have a quick chat about what you are interested in and your past experience.
You will then be invited to complete a programming exercise at your own pace via TestDome – typically around an hour of coding, done whenever suits you best.
If the exercise goes well, we’ll invite you for a final conversation with one of our team – around an hour to dig into your experience, values, and of course an opportunity for you to ask us questions. You will then get feedback on our decision either way – and we might even make you an offer there and then!

We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note: This role is Poland based and candidates are required to have the legal right to work in the Poland for employment.
A background check (including criminal records check and references) is required for this role.
NewOrbit are committed to a safe work environment that supports and respects equality, diversity and inclusion within our team.

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.

• Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem

new_jobs.title: Full-Stack Agile Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Full-Stack Agile Software Engineer

Location:
Solna, Stockholm, Sweden
Start Date:
5th October 2026
End Date:
31st March 2027
Work Style:
Hybrid - Minimum 2 Office Days Weekly - 40 Hours Weekly

Role Objective
Develop and maintain innovative, accessible, and secure web applications that provide effective end-to-end business solutions. Contribute as part of a collaborative Agile DevSecOps team focused on learning, openness, and continuous improvement. Deliver maintainable, well-tested software that meets user needs and applicable IT and information-security requirements.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain web-based applications with a focus on end-to-end solutions.
Collaborate closely with UX and UI designers to create user-friendly and accessible digital experiences.
Work iteratively using Agile methods, test-driven development, and DevSecOps practices.
Contribute practical problem-solving, technical ideas, and continuous improvements.
Represent and support the web-development perspective within wider business projects.
Document technical solutions, decisions, and delivery processes.
Apply secure software-development practices in accordance with legal, IT-security, and information-security frameworks.

Tasks
Develop frontend functionality using JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, and Angular 18 or later.
Develop backend services and application components using C# and .NET.
Design and consume REST-based integrations using JSON and XML.
Build and release software using Azure DevOps and cloud-based services.
Create responsive interfaces using CSS frameworks such as Tailwind or Bootstrap.
Develop and maintain content-management solutions, preferably using EpiServer or Optimizely.
Implement authentication and authorisation using OAuth and OpenID technologies.
Use development and API-testing tools including Visual Studio and Postman.
Create unit tests and automated tests to maintain software quality and delivery confidence.
Collaborate with team members from different technical and professional backgrounds.

Deliverables
Production-ready frontend and backend application features.
Accessible, secure, and user-focused web solutions.
Reliable REST integrations and cloud-based application components.
Automated unit and functional tests supporting consistent code quality.
Clear technical documentation and effective knowledge sharing.

Decision Authority / Responsibility
Own assigned application features from clarification and development through testing and release.

new_jobs.description:
2026-09-14

Vill du arbeta med den senaste teknologin och som del av ett scrum-team, med stöd av kompetenta och trevliga kollegor i en kreativ och internationell miljö? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som systemutvecklare på Uppsala universitet.

National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS) söker nu ytterligare 1 systemutvecklare. Vi är en nationell infrastruktur vars syfte är att tillhandahålla support för bioinformatiker och forskare inom livsvetenskaperna. Systemutvecklingsgruppen består av två scrumteam som utvecklar verktyg för storskalig datahantering och webbapplikationer för forskargrupper och EU-finansierade projekt, allt inom området bioinformatik.

Att vara en del av ett av våra team ger dig möjlighet att göra skillnad, genom att arbeta i projekt vars mål är att göra forskningsdata säker och delbar. Du kommer att vara anställd vid Uppsala universitet, på Institutionen för cell- och molekylärbiologi (ICM), och vara knuten till NBIS och Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab). Mer information om NBIS finns på https://nbis.se.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare kommer du att vara ansvarig för utveckling och underhåll av en delningsplattform för mänsklig genomikdata från forskningsprojekt, i samarbete med våra partners i andra europeiska länder. Målet med dessa projekt, som Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), är att hjälpa forskare att kunna dela sin data på ett säkert vis, och att på så sätt underlätta deras samarbeten runt mänsklig hälsa och medicin.

Projektet GDI handlar om att möjliggöra säker tillgång till genomiska och kliniska data inom EU, för att kunna förbättra klinisk diagnostik, behandlingar och prediktiv medicin. Bigpicture är ett annat europeiskt flaggskepp som syftar till att bygga en Petabyte plattform för AI inom digital patologi. Våra samarbetspartner kommer från akademin såväl som sjukvården och industrin.

Du kommer arbeta tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklare i ett av våra scrum-team och bidra till de ovan nämnda projekten. Scrum-teamet är ansvarig för produkternas hela livscykel, från planering och utveckling, till driftsättning och underhåll. Du kommer vara del av ett team som värdesätter kreativitet och ser gärna att du är med och påverkar alla beslut inom gruppen.

Kvalifikationskrav

Du som sökande skall minst ha kandidatexamen inom informationsteknik, datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller bioinformatik, alternativt motsvarande dokumenterad kompetens inom ett eller flera av dessa områden.

Vidare Krävs

Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i systemutveckling med Python och Java
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Kubernetes med Helm och Hashicorp Vault eller OpenBao
Minst fem års erfarenhet av databaser, t. ex. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet av virtualiseringslösningar och mjukvaru-containrar (t.ex. Docker eller Podman)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git och CI/CD (t. ex. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt enligt scrum och scrum-rollerna certifikat (scrummaster eller produktägare)
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Infrastructure as Code med Terraform och Ansible och ett eller flera molnleverantörer (t. ex. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
Minst fem års erfarenhet och god förståelse av nätverk (TLS, TCP/UDP, HTTPS, routing)
Att du kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet, den sökande ska ha mycket god samarbetsförmåga, initiativförmåga och goda kommunikativa kvaliteter.

Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt

Följande Räknas Som Meriterande

Vana att arbeta i fysiskt distribuerade team med kommunikation och koordination via elektroniska verktyg som videomöten och liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med informationssäkerhet är starkt meriterande
God förståelse av mekanismer för autentisering och auktorisation (t. ex. OAuth, JWT)
Kunskap om bioinformatik, i synnerhet är erfarenhet av verktyg och metoder för analys av human genomikdata särskilt efterfrågat.
Erfarenhet av verktyg för projektmanagement, t. ex. Zenhub, Jira.
Erfarenhet av arbete med infrastruktursystem för känsliga data, speciellt inom den offentliga sektorn eller akademin.

Anställningen är tillsvidare (provanställning om 6 månader kan tillämpas). Omfattningen är heltid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort: Uppsala

new_jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Own the backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix.

Oplane is an always-on security expert for AI-first engineering teams. Our biggest focus today is PR Analysis: every pull request reviewed against the customer’s architectural threat model before it merges, with findings and code-level fixes attached rather than a report handed over. Scanners find patterns. Oplane understands the system. That is where we are now, not where we stop, and we ship new capabilities constantly.

You are a senior hire on that backend. There is a working system with paying enterprise customers on it, so you are not starting from a blank repo, but large parts of it are still the first version that got us here and need someone senior to make them hold at scale.

What you’ll own
The backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix. Design, correctness, and the parts of reliability that live in the application layer.

What the job actually is
· Design and build the core backend. Python services, clean APIs, and the system design behind turning a customer’s code into a threat model and driving the fix. The analysis itself is AI-driven, so a lot of the interesting design is in orchestrating models reliably, not just moving data around. You own real system design here, not tickets handed to you fully specified.
· Build the APIs the product lives or dies by. Oplane only works when it is embedded in a customer’s repos, CI, pull request flow and coding agents. Part of that surface is how external coding agents talk to Oplane and run threat modeling directly. It has to be clean, stable, and hard to break, because other people’s pipelines and agents depend on it.
· Make it hold at enterprise scale. Companies with thousands of engineers, large codebases, concurrent analysis, and a lot of sensitive input passing through. You care about throughput, correct handling of customer code and secrets, and failure modes that do not silently drop a finding.
· Build the agentic way, because we mean it. This is the most agent-native codebase you are likely to have worked in. Our docs are written for coding agents to read, an agent reviews our pull requests, and we are building for a world where agents write most of the code. You will plan with an agent, build with one, and review with one, every day. We grow through agents rather than headcount, and if that reads as a threat to your craft rather than a multiplier of it, this is the wrong team.
· Work close to security. The whole product is about security architecture, and the team lives it, from prompt injection to secure-by-design, as a daily concern rather than an annual audit. You do not have to arrive as a security expert, but security experience is a real plus, and you should want to get good at it, because it is the domain the code is about.

Who this is for
· Around 10 years building backend systems in production. Depth in APIs, data, and system design matters more than any single language, and Python is a plus rather than a requirement.

What you get

· Real ownership of the backend, working directly with the founders.
· Backed by Seed Capital and Icebreaker.vc, with angel investors from Neo4j and Google, including Emil Eifrem. $5.2M seed.
· Based at our Malmö office, on-site five days a week. This is an in-person engineering team by design, not a distributed one.

How we work
Small team, ten of us today, real autonomy, and nothing between deciding something and doing it. We are honest about what is hard, including in this ad. Etuihimme Kuuluu

Markkinatasoinen työsuhde-etujen paketti sisältäen:
Lounas ja virike-etu
Työterveyshuolto
Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi

Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:
Online-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
Koulutukset ja community-tapaamiset
Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)

Paljon vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:
Koko firman tapahtumat
Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e-urheilu, padel.

Tehtävään Hakeminen

Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!

Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Onko sinulla kysymyksiä,
esimerkiksi hakemukseen tai toimiston esteettömyyteen liittyen, joihin toivoisit meidän vastaavan ennen hakemuksen jättämistä?

Voit ottaa yhteyttä rekrytointitiimiimme careers.fi@twoday.com ja palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian vastausten kera.

Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

Työskentely Twodaylla

Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI-suunnittelijat.
Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

Kenen kanssa työskentelet?

Työskentelet osana T woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.

Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

Odotamme Sinulta

Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus.
Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: C#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript.
Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle.
Pilviosaamista: Azure tai AWS.
Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
Englannin kielen osaaminen.
Olet oma-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

Jos Sinulla On Kokemusta Jostain Seuraavista Osaamisista

Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
Integraatioista.
Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.

Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can-do -asenteella.

new_jobs.title: Software Architect
new_jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Architect who designs comprehensive technical solutions to bridge business problems with technology, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, security, and scalability. In your work you create architecture blueprints, select technology stacks, and lead implementation teams, acting as a crucial link between stakeholders and developers.

The role is based in our Espoo or Tampere office, and the work will be done in a hybrid model according to our needs.

Your Main Responsibilities

Sales and presales: Identifying customer needs and proposing bold solutions.
Architecture Design: Creating detailed architecture specifications, diagrams, and documentation for software and infrastructure.
Strategic Alignment: Mapping business requirements to technical solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
Technology Selection: Evaluating and recommending tools, platforms, and frameworks that align with technical strategies.
Implementation Oversight: Guiding development teams during implementation to ensure adherence to the designed architecture.
Stakeholder Management: Communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and acting as a bridge between teams.

Your Required Skills And Experience

Technical Expertise: Strong background in software engineering (minimum 10 years), system integration, infrastructure, and cloud technologies (e.g., Azure, AWS).
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex problems and design effective, creative solutions.
Leadership: Ability and proven track-record in leading teams and guiding technical decision-making.
Project Management: Experience with SDLC, Agile methodologies, and managing project risks.
A Master’s degree in computer science or related field.
Extensive experience in software design, development, and IT infrastructure.
Experience in a technical leadership role.
Language skills: fluent English and Finnish

We also value

Entrepreneurial mindset
Deeper domain knowledge of industrial manufacturing

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 6000-7000€/month, depending on your background.

new_jobs.description:
Etsimme Sovelluskehittäjää
vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Sijainti:
Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

Vastuualueet

Sovelluskehittäjänä:

Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI-suunnittelijat.
Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

Kenen kanssa työskentelet?

Työskentelet osana T woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.

Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

Odotamme Sinulta

Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus.
Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: C#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript.
Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle.
Pilviosaamista: Azure tai AWS.
Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
Englannin kielen osaaminen.
Olet oma-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

Katsomme eduksi

Jos Sinulla On Kokemusta Jostain Seuraavista Osaamisista

Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
Integraatioista.
Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.

Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can-do -asenteella.

Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?

Ensimmäisen Kuuden Kuukauden Tavoitteesi Kiteytettynä

Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.
Olet päässyt hyvin osaksi työyhteisöä ja osoittautunut loistavaksi lisäksi tiimiimme.
Olet sisäistänyt asiakkaan toimialan ja perehtynyt sisään hankkeeseen.
Osaamisesi on osoittautunut relevantiksi asiakasprojekteissamme.

Auttaaksemme sinua menestymään, tarjoamme sinulle perehdytysohjelman, koulutuksia, sertifikaatteja sekä työyhteisön, joka omalla osaamisellaan ja tekemisellään tukee työssä oppimistasi ja urakehitystäsi. Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?

Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

Etuihimme Kuuluu

Markkinatasoinen työsuhde-etujen paketti sisältäen:
Lounas ja virike-etu
Työterveyshuolto
Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi

Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:
Online-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
Koulutukset ja community-tapaamiset
Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)

Paljon vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:
Koko firman tapahtumat
Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e-urheilu, padel.

Tehtävään Hakeminen

Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!

Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Onko sinulla kysymyksiä,
esimerkiksi hakemukseen tai toimiston esteettömyyteen liittyen, joihin toivoisit meidän vastaavan ennen hakemuksen jättämistä?

Voit ottaa yhteyttä rekrytointitiimiimme careers.fi@twoday.com ja palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian vastausten kera.

Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

Työskentely Twodaylla

Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Other

Job function

Engineering and Information Technology

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

I Bygma tilbyder vi faglig dybde og geografisk bredde. Derfor har du store muligheder, når du vil lægge næste lag på din karriere. I salg eller i stab. På lager eller i ledelse. Sådan hjælper vi med at bygge Danmark.

Fastansat/tidsbegrænset: Fastansat

Timer: 37.0

Erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma Gruppen

Vil du udvikle digitale løsninger og samtidig tage ansvar for at drive udviklingsopgaver fremad sammen med teamet?

Vi søger en erfaren Fullstack-udvikler til Bygma IT & Digitalisering. Du bliver en del af vores interne udviklingsteam, hvor vi arbejder med alt fra websites, CMS og e-commerce til webapplikationer, API'er og integrationer.

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning - fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af Bygma IT & Digitalisering med ca. 35 kolleger og får en central rolle i udviklingsteamet med reference til Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov. Stillingen er med base på vores hovedkontor i Søborg.

Du arbejder selv hands-on med udviklingen og tager samtidig en drivende teknisk rolle i større opgaver. Sammen med interessenter og resten af teamet omsætter du behov fra forretningen til gode tekniske løsninger, får opgaverne brudt ned og bidrager til at skabe fremdrift hele vejen til implementering.

Vi arbejder tæt på forretningen og de løsninger, der er i brug hver dag. Derfor består jobbet både af nye udviklingsopgaver og den løbende videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger. Det betyder også, at du sammen med teamet tager fat på bugs, mindre forbedringer og konkrete forespørgsler fra forretningen, når de opstår.

Dine Opgaver Bliver Bl.a. At

udvikle og videreudvikle fullstack webapplikationer og digitale løsninger
tage ansvar for løsningsbeskrivelse og teknisk afklaring
nedbryde større udviklingsopgaver og drive dem fremad sammen med teamet
videreudvikle vores CMS- og e-commerce-platforme
udvikle både frontend og backend samt API'er og integrationer
håndtere bugs, forbedringer og løbende behov fra forretningen
sikre stabile, vedligeholdelsesvenlige løsninger, der er effektive at drifte
sparre om arkitektur, teknologi og best practices

Din profil

Du har flere års erfaring med fullstack webudvikling og gerne solid erfaring med CMS og e-commerce.

Vi leder efter en reel fullstack-profil, som er stærk i .NET/C#, men som også har solid erfaring med frontend-udvikling og selv arbejder med Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript og moderne webteknologier. Du trives med at arbejde på tværs af hele løsningen - fra brugerfladen i frontend til API'er, integrationer og data bagved.

Du trives med hele spændet i udviklingsarbejdet. Den ene opgave kan være en større ny funktion, den næste en fejl i en eksisterende løsning eller en konkret forespørgsel fra en kollega i forretningen. For dig er det naturligt at tage ansvar for begge dele.

Du har også blik for løsningen, når den er sat i produktion. Drift er en naturlig del af vores udviklingsansvar, og du tænker derfor stabilitet, performance, vedligeholdelse og effektiv drift ind i de løsninger, du er med til at bygge.

Vi Arbejder Bl.a. Med

.NET / C#
CMS og e-commerce – vi anvender pt. Optimizely / Episerver
Angular
JavaScript / TypeScript
SQL og databaser
Web API'er og integrationer

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af Bygmas digitale platforme og mulighed for at præge både løsninger og tekniske valg.

Hos os er IT tæt på forretningen. Vejen fra idé til implementering er kort, og det, du udvikler, bliver hurtigt brugt i praksis. Vi følger vores løsninger efter implementering og arbejder løbende med både drift, forbedringer og videreudvikling.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for at få tingene i mål.

Kan du se dig selv hos os?

Så søg jobbet via linket på denne side. Fristen er 8. oktober 2026. Vi holder løbende samtaler og kan derfor vælge den rette kandidat inden ansøgningsfristens udløb. Så skynd dig at sende os din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov på jefe@bygma.dk.

Om Bygma Gruppen

Bygma Gruppen A/S er den største danskejede leverandør af byggematerialer til det professionelle byggeri, og vi giver vores kunder rådgivning, service og kvalitet på branchens højeste niveau.

new_jobs.description:
About Ragnar Solutions

Ragnar Solutions Romania is the Romanian branch of Ragnar Solutions BV, a growing software company based in the Netherlands.
We build and maintain Deimos
, an e-invoicing integration platform used for compliance accross PEPPOL (multi-country), France, Poland, Spain and more.
E-invoicing is becoming mandatory in more and more countries, but every country has different rules, formats, and government systems. Deimos handles that complexity for our clients, helping make sure
their invoices are processed correctly and delivered to the right systems on time.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-level Full-Stack Developer
to join the team building Deimos.
You will own features end to end: from the CSV/SFTP intake and the background jobs that talk to national e-invoicing systems (Poland's KSeF, Spain's VeriFactu, the Peppol network) through to the Angular portals where clients see the result.

Our Stack

How it's built

A multi-tenant platform: two Angular portals (client and admin), an API gateway in front of two ASP.NET Core APIs, and multiple .NET background services
Services talk over RabbitMQ; calls to external systems go through an outbox with idempotent retries
Integrations over REST, SOAP and SFTP, with XML built and validated against official schemas (Peppol BIS / UBL, Poland's FA(3))

Backend

C# 14 on .NET 10, ASP.NET Core
Entity Framework Core with PostgreSQL
RabbitMQ, Serilog
xUnit and Moq

Front-end

Angular 20, standalone components and signals
TypeScript, RxJS, Tailwind CSS
Nx monorepo with libraries shared by both portals
Playwright for end-to-end tests

Tooling and Infrastructure

Docker and Docker Compose
GitLab CI for builds, tests and deployments
HashiCorp Vault for configuration and secrets

What you will do

Own features across backend, frontend, tests and docs
Build and maintain integrations with national e-invoicing authorities
Work with XML schemas: build documents, validate them, debug rejections from the authority
Design background jobs: import pipelines, outbox-based sync workers, retries, idempotency
Investigate production issues independently across services (logs, queues, database)
Keep tenant isolation and authorization intact in everything you touch
Review code and mentor junior developers

What we are looking for

3+ years professional C#/.NET, including ASP.NET Core APIs
Solid EF Core and relational DB skills (PostgreSQL preferred): migrations, indexing, query performance
Angular + TypeScript + RxJS, comfortable with forms, tables, reusable components; signals a plus
Message-based / asynchronous processing (RabbitMQ or similar): at-least-once delivery, idempotency, retries
Unit and integration tests as part of "done" (xUnit, Moq)
Comfortable integrating third-party APIs (REST, SOAP) and reading XML/XSD
Can debug a distributed issue on your own
Git/PR workflow, gives useful code review

Nice to have

E-invoicing, Peppol, UBL or any tax-authority integration
Multi-tenant SaaS
Docker Compose, GitLab CI, Vault
File-based integrations (SFTP, CSV)
Auth: JWT, FIDO2/passkeys, RBAC
Nx monorepos, Playwright

What we offer

Salary range between 7000 and 11000 RON (net), depending on experience
Hybrid working environment
Meal tickets
Medlife Gold private medical insurance
End of year bonus
Performance bonus
Access to courses for continued professional development

Our hiring process

We keep it short and transparent:

Intro call to talk about your background, the role, and what you are looking for.
Take-home assignment, described below.
Technical discussion (around an hour) where we go through your assignment together.
Final conversation with the team, and an offer.

About the take-home assignment

The assignment is a small full-stack task scoped to around 4 hours: a .NET API that accepts invoice-like records, a background worker that processes them from a queue (idempotent, with retries), and a small Angular page that shows the outcome. We care about how you structure and test it, not about polish. You have one week to hand it in.

new_jobs.title: Azure Integration / Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

While Xebia is a global tech company, our journey in CEE started with two Polish companies – PGS Software, known for world-class cloud and software solutions, and GetInData, a pioneer in Big Data. Today, we’re a team of 1,000+ experts delivering top-notch work across cloud, data, and software. And we’re just getting started.
What We Do

We work on projects that matter – and that make a difference. From fintech and e-commerce to aviation, logistics, media, and fashion, we help our clients build scalable platforms, data and AI solutions, and cutting-edge applications to shape the future of tech. Our clients include McLaren, Aviva, Deloitte, Spotify, Disney, ING, UPS, Tesco, Truecaller, AllSaints, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, Allegro, InPost, and many, many more.
We value smart tech, real ownership, and continuous growth. We use modern, open-source stacks, and we’re proud to be trusted partners of Databricks, dbt, Snowflake, Azure, GCP, and AWS. Fun fact: we were the first AWS Premier Partner in Poland!
Beyond Projects

What makes Xebia special? Our community. We support tech communities, organize meetups (Software Talks, Data Tech Talks), and have a culture that actively support your growth via Guilds, Labs, and personal development budgets — for both tech and soft skills. It’s not just a job. It’s a place to grow.
What sets us apart?

Our mindset. Our vibe. Our people. And while that’s hard to capture in text – come visit us and see for yourself.

You will be:

owning end-to-end solution architecture for Azure-based integration solutions,
designing integration patterns connecting Salesforce, Azure microservices, MuleSoft, banking systems, and legacy platforms,
defining API-first and event-driven architectures, including interface contracts, messaging, error handling, and reconciliation strategies,
designing cloud-native solutions using AKS, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Blob Storage,
defining authentication, authorization, and least-privilege security models in line with GDPR and client security standards,
defining non-functional requirements covering availability, scalability, performance, RPO/RTO, disaster recovery, security, and observability,
preparing and presenting solution designs, technical analyses, and architectural specifications to client stakeholders,
governing architecture changes, leading design reviews, and driving cross-team technical decisions.

Your profile:

have proven experience as an Integration Architect, Solution Architect, or similar role within an Azure ecosystem,
practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery,
have strong hands-on knowledge of Azure services, particularly AKS, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, Blob Storage, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps,
have strong experience designing enterprise integration solutions and distributed systems,
understand API-first, REST, event-driven, asynchronous messaging, and contract-first integration patterns,
have experience integrating cloud solutions with Salesforce, banking systems, MuleSoft, or legacy platforms,
understand cloud security architecture and Secure-by-Design principles,
have knowledge of authentication and authorization concepts including OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC, SSO, MFA, and secrets management,
have experience defining non-functional requirements, disaster recovery strategies, monitoring, and operational readiness,
have strong architecture documentation and governance skills,
demonstrate excellent stakeholder management and communication skills,
can influence architectural direction, manage technical risks, and act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders,
have English and Italian language skills at B2/C1 level.

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

Nice to have:

experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily work,
interest in and familiarity with emerging AI-driven practices (e.g. agent-based workflows, automation patterns, AI-augmented development), with a willingness to explore and experiment beyond standard approaches.

CV
review – HR
call – Technical Interview
– Client
Interview – Decision

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

More Than a Job: A Mission

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Designer in Istanbul to shape cutting-edge digital solutions for modern mobility systems. You'll work alongside people who show up with ownership, passion, and dedication.

Your Role, Your Impact

Design and develop scalable front-end and back-end components for transportation software applications.
Ensure robust integration of web interfaces with complex system infrastructures.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver seamless digital experiences.
Optimize systems for performance, security, and user accessibility in real-world environments.
Contribute to innovative solutions that enhance safe, efficient, and sustainable mobility.

You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility. Your expertise in full-stack design will help link technology and transport for global connectivity.

What You Bring

Proficiency in both front-end (JavaScript frameworks, HTML, CSS) and back-end (Java, .NET, or similar) development.
Experience with relational databases and cloud-based architectures.
Strong understanding of software design principles and agile methodologies.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Excellent problem-solving skills with a collaborative mindset.

How Success Is Measured

Delivery of high-quality, user-centric software solutions on time.

Positive collaboration and proactive engagement within cross-functional teams.

Alstom, A Great Place to Grow

new_jobs.title: Solutions Architect
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Turkey.

This is a strategic and advisory architecture role focused on shaping complex, multi-domain platforms for scalability, security, reliability, and long-term sustainability.

You will define architecture strategy, technical roadmaps, and reference patterns while guiding engineering teams through complex technical decisions.

The role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.

You will bridge pre-sales and delivery, ensuring client solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with long-term platform realities.

While the position is primarily architecture-focused, you will remain hands-on when greenfield initiatives, prototypes, or critical architectural decisions require deeper technical involvement.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Benefits

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to broader engineering maturity and leadership development.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
