Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead architecture design, drive technology decisions, and co-create innovative products while mentoring clients to adopt Agile practices and engineering excellence. Your role offers hands-on collaboration, diverse industry exposure, and opportunities to shape solutions and grow as a technology leader.

You will lead project workstreams, drive architectural decisions, and build scalable solutions using Agile methodologies. Working closely with client teams, you will co-create products, foster a culture of engineering excellence, and mentor teams in best practices. Your responsibilities will include shaping technical strategies, making key technology decisions, and ensuring the delivery of impactful, user-centric solutions.

Your work will have a lasting impact beyond the products you build. By collaborating with client leadership, you will influence their digital strategies, help scale their engineering cultures, and enable them to achieve sustainable growth. Each project will expose you to diverse industries and technologies, providing opportunities to learn and grow while shaping the future of technology.

You will design and deliver next-generation products that transform businesses across industries. You will be based in Madrid or Lisbon and will be part of QuantumBlack AI by McKinsey, a multidisciplinary group of software engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, and technology consultant passionate about creating industry-shaping products and tools.

Your role offers unparalleled opportunities for growth and innovation. At McKinsey, you’ll have a seat at the table with client leaders, the chance to shape product strategies, and the freedom to explore areas of personal interest. new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Portugal.

This is a strategic and advisory architecture role focused on shaping complex, multi-domain platforms for scalability, security, reliability, and long-term sustainability.

You will define architecture strategy, technical roadmaps, and reference patterns while guiding engineering teams through complex technical decisions.

The role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.

You will bridge pre-sales and delivery, ensuring client solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with long-term platform realities.

While the position is primarily architecture-focused, you will remain hands-on when greenfield initiatives, prototypes, or critical architectural decisions require deeper technical involvement.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, Leadership, and clients while influencing senior technical teams through expertise rather than formal authority.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced architect who can raise technical maturity while remaining closely connected to delivery.

Accountabilities

Define detailed architecture blueprints, system designs, technical standards, reference patterns, and long-term technology roadmaps for complex platforms.
Design scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable distributed systems and integrations while balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational complexity.
Act as the primary architectural authority, guiding technical direction and modernization strategies across mature and evolving systems.
Architect and optimize cloud or hybrid infrastructures, including networking, IAM/RBAC, compute, storage, monitoring, security, governance, resilience, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and automation strategies using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or native cloud tooling.
Guide DevOps adoption, CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, release workflows, environment management, observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Support engineering teams with complex debugging, incident resolution, performance improvements, and architectural refactoring from a systems-level perspective.
Contribute selectively to architecture-critical code, prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews, design reviews, and technical troubleshooting when hands-on involvement is required.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success during pre-sales to assess technical feasibility, shape solution approaches, participate in discovery and proposals, and validate delivery commitments.
Ensure architectural context and decisions transition effectively from pre-sales into delivery and early project planning.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and modern automation approaches.
Mentor engineers and technical leads, identify capability gaps, promote engineering best practices, and strengthen overall architectural and technical maturity.
Influence senior technical stakeholders through strong communication, credibility, and sound judgment without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in architecture-focused roles.
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
Have proven experience designing, delivering, and evolving distributed systems in production, including large-scale or mission-critical environments.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, event-driven design, messaging, queues, buses, event-management systems, SQL, data models, and databases.
Have solid understanding of Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, TDD, EDD, Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service, security, governance, observability, and resilience.
Be capable of reading, understanding, and reasoning about complex codebases across multiple technologies, with sufficient code literacy to guide architectural decisions.
Have strong familiarity with modern cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure, including experience with Azure or comparable platforms.
Demonstrate experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automation, infrastructure architecture, and production operations.
Possess strong architectural judgment and a systems-thinking mindset, combined with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and demonstrate strong ownership in evolving and ambiguous environments.
Be comfortable influencing and guiding senior engineers without direct authority while respecting their expertise and autonomy.
Demonstrate curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies and new architectural approaches.
Experience modernizing legacy systems, evolving mature platforms, working with cloud-native or containerized architectures, microservices, workflow orchestration, event-driven platforms, or AI/ML integration is a plus.
Cloud or architecture-related certifications are considered an additional advantage.

Benefits

Long-term, full-time employment.
Fully remote work.
Competitive salary in USD, based on the role and experience.
20+ paid time-off days.
Opportunity to work on complex, multi-domain technology platforms and influence long-term architectural strategy.
Exposure to cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, DevOps, automation, and modern software architecture.
Opportunities to mentor technical teams and contribute to broader engineering maturity and leadership development.

Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

Project Description:

The Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) system is a cloud native software platform whose main task is the automation of business processes. FARO is based on a microservice architecture written in C# .NET. It provides process control (so called MissionScheduler) and connects to 3rd party systems in the environment of the processes (so called connectors). In the future FARO will enable our new process platform Camunda with connectors. The team in addition to developing connectors for FARO will also be responsible to develop templates and APIs for Camunda.

Activity Description:

As a Fullstack engineer you are part of a team which is responsible for process automation for fixed access network projects within Telekom Deutschland. You will be part of an innovative and agile work environment where you will be implementing future-oriented software solutions to manage and plan the hardware rollout for the fixed access network.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend microservices using C# .NET within a Kubernetes-orchestrated environment
Implement and improve traceability, observability, and stability of the growing microservice architecture through monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Dapr
Develop and enhance frontend components using Angular to deliver responsive user interfaces and support rapid feature deployment
Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration connectors for FARO and Camunda process automation platform
Model, configure, and optimise business processes using BPMN standards within the Camunda ecosystem
Containerise applications using Docker and manage deployment pipelines within Kubernetes clusters
Conduct code reviews, share technical expertise, and provide constructive feedback throughout the development lifecycle to maintain code quality and team growth
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks and system issues across the microservice architecture
Contribute to the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation processes
Drive innovation by evaluating and implementing emerging technologies and best practices in software development, including design patterns, clean code principles, and test-driven development

Qualifications

Must-Have Skills:

You hold a degree in informatics, computer science, or a related field
You have multiple years of professional experience as either a Fullstack or Backend Developer
You are proficient in at least one object-oriented programming language, preferably C#
You have hands-on experience with containerisation using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
You have practical experience with Camunda and are proficient in BPMN process modelling
You have experience in configuring and developing monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Dapr
You are well-versed in common software development best practices including design patterns, clean code principles, test-driven development (TDD), and version control systems (Git)
You possess proficient knowledge of microservice architectures, preferably with .NET and Kubernetes
You have experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and integration connectors
You are analytical and solution-oriented in your approach to problem-solving
You are driven by a willingness to grow and continuously push yourself and your team to explore innovative ideas
You thrive in an agile work environment and embrace collaborative development practices
You are interested in telecommunication technologies and their applications

About the Company

Phi Partners is a global capital markets technology consultancy, offering a range of services, technology solutions, and advisory support to investment banks, hedge funds, and asset managers. Since its founding in 2004, Phi has expanded its presence worldwide, with headquarters in London and offices across North America, EMEA, and APAC. Our expertise in high-impact areas such as Quantitative, Front Office, and Risk Technology sets us apart, enabling us to collaborate with some of the world's most prominent financial institutions. We specialize in delivering robust, scalable, and cloud-based solutions, supporting clients across their digital transformation journeys.

About the Role

Phi Partners is supporting one of the world’s largest, most influential sovereign wealth funds that has a diverse portfolio covering every asset class across every major geographical region globally. Our client is building a low-latency, event-driven trading platform on Azure. The programme focuses on delivering a high-performance, regulated architecture using Solace messaging, AKS and cloud-native services. This role will perform the end-to-end quality & automation testing and compliance assurance for the data platforms and ETL pipelines linked to the trading platform, ensuring the platform meets performance, resiliency and audit requirements for regulated markets.

Responsibilities

This role is ideal for a highly skilled Software Engineer in Test.
Key responsibilities include:
Define and execute test strategy across unit, integration, contract, E2E, and performance for the data platforms (databricks, snowflake) and ETL pipelines.
Support incident response, root cause analysis and production verification activities.
Automate data quality checks for market/reference data, order/trade states, and downstream stores (SQL Server/Azure SQL).
Implement reconciliation across OMS/EMS, risk, and settlement; verify lineage and PII/PCI masking where relevant.
Use SQL and profiling to validate accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and SCD/versioned data behaviors.
Manage golden datasets and synthetic market data at scale for repeatable regression.

Required Skills

Key Skills The ideal candidate will have:
Experience with implementing and defining test automation strategies for data platforms.
Hands-on experience building automation frameworks using C# and/or Python with xUnit, NUnit, MSTest or PyTest, integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
Strong experience with SQL Server or Azure SQL.
Experience with Databricks or Snowflake.
Experience testing APIs (REST/GraphQL/SOAP) and implementing contract testing.
Experience performing performance testing using JMeter or LoadRunner for latency, throughput, spike and failover scenarios.
Experience supporting financial/trading systems, including order lifecycle, market data and risk controls is highly preferred.

QuickFIX/N (FIX testing), schema registry tools, ISTQB Advanced/CSTE, Azure certifications, Agile/Scrum.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a talented individual to join a leading capital markets technology consultancy and work on a strategic trading platform programme, offering strong technical ownership within a cloud-native, regulated environment.

began its journey in 1973
with one store in Bahrain and has grown into one of the largest retail and hospitality conglomerates in the Middle East, Africa, and India.
Currently, the Group operates over 2,200 outlets, encompassing over 30 million square feet across 21 countries.
Job PurposeThe Technical Architect is responsible for defining and guiding the technical and application architecture for enterprise solutions. The role translates business requirements into scalable, secure, and practical solution designs across applications, integrations, cloud platforms, data flows, and enterprise systems.

Key Focus Areas:

Application Architecture
Solution Design
AI Enabled Application Architecture
Application Modernization
Cloud and Platform Enablement
Cross Domain Application Alignment
Infrastructure and Security Driven Application Design
Drive Innovation

Job Description
Application Architecture

Design end-to-end application architectures across enterprise platforms, custom applications, SaaS solutions, cloud services, and digital systems
Define application architecture standards, patterns, and best practices for modular design, service design, maintainability, scalability, performance, reliability, and supportability
Guide teams on application structure, component design, technology selection, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles
Ensure application designs support business capabilities, operational needs, security expectations, and long-term technology direction

Application Solution Design

Translate business requirements into practical end-to-end technical designs and solution options
Evaluate solution alternatives, identify technical risks, assess cost versus benefit, and recommend fit-for-purpose architecture decisions
Create solution designs that consider applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure, security, operations, and delivery constraints
Provide technical guidance during delivery to ensure the implemented solution remains aligned with the approved design

AI Enabled Application Architecture

Identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation, machine learning, and generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business processes
Guide application teams on AI enabled solution patterns, including intelligent search, document processing, recommendation engines, conversational interfaces, workflow automation, and decision support
Ensure AI-enabled application designs consider data quality, privacy, security, access control, auditability, explainability, operational support, and responsible AI principles
Work with data, integration, security, infrastructure, and platform teams to ensure AI solutions are properly connected to enterprise data, APIs, cloud services, and application platforms
Support evaluation of AI tools, platforms, APIs, and vendor capabilities to determine fit-for-purpose use cases and enterprise adoption
Ensure AI capabilities are designed as part of the application architecture, not as disconnected experiments or standalone proof of concepts

Application Modernization

Support legacy application assessment, rationalization, modernization, and simplification initiatives
Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, remove duplication, consolidate platforms, and improve application maintainability
Guide modernization approaches including replatforming, refactoring, replacement, cloud adoption, containerization, and service enablement
Partner with business and technology teams to define practical transition states from current architecture to target architecture

Infrastructure and Security Aware Application Design

Ensure application designs properly consider hosting, compute, storage, network, identity, access, security controls, performance, resilience, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and operational support requirements
Work closely with infrastructure and security architects to align application designs with enterprise infrastructure, cloud, network, and security standards
Incorporate security by design principles including identity and access management, role based access, encryption, secure APIs, data protection, vulnerability management, and compliance needs
Validate that applications are designed for availability, scalability, observability, supportability, and production readiness

Cloud and Platform Enablement

Guide the use of cloud services, enterprise platforms, DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, environment strategy, and deployment patterns
Support application teams in adopting cloud native and platform capabilities where they provide business and technical value
Ensure cloud and platform choices are secure, scalable, cost effective, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards
Collaborate with platform, DevOps, infrastructure, and engineering teams to improve delivery speed, reliability, and operational maturity

Cross Domain Application Alignment

Work closely with enterprise, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and platform architects to ensure application solutions are aligned across the broader technology landscape
Ensure application designs properly address integration points, data movement, master data needs, reporting dependencies, security controls, infrastructure impact, and operational dependencies
Maintain clear ownership boundaries with specialized architecture domains while ensuring end-to-end solution integrity
Identify reuse opportunities across applications, platforms, services, APIs, and shared technical capabilities

Architecture Governance & Compliance Alignment

Work with the Architecture Review Board, enterprise architecture team, and domain architects to ensure application and technical solution designs follow approved architecture standards, principles, and governance processes
Support architecture review submissions by preparing solution architecture documents, design diagrams, technical decision records, risk assessments, and required review materials
Review application and technical designs for alignment with enterprise standards across application architecture, integration, data, infrastructure, security, cloud, and operational readiness
Identify architecture risks, design gaps, technical debt, compliance concerns, and operational impacts early in the solution lifecycle
Ensure application solutions consider security, privacy, data protection, resilience, disaster recovery, audit, and regulatory requirements in partnership with the relevant domain owners
Track architecture decisions, exceptions, risks, and follow-up actions through the appropriate governance forums and delivery checkpoints

Leadership & Collaboration

Serve as subject matter expert and technical advisor for infrastructure and security initiatives
Mentor engineering teams on architecture principles, security best practices, and technology adoption
Collaborate with enterprise architects, application teams, and business stakeholders to align technical solutions with business needs
Lead architectural reviews, provide technical guidance, and resolve design conflicts
Stay current with industry trends, emerging threats, and innovative technologies

Documentation & Knowledge Management

Create and maintain solution architecture documents, application architecture diagrams, system context diagrams, data flow diagrams, deployment views, technical design documents, and architecture decision records
Document key design decisions, architecture assumptions, technical risks, dependencies, exceptions, standards, reusable patterns, and open issues
Maintain architecture artifacts required for Architecture Review Board reviews, delivery governance, production readiness, operational handover, and future system changes
Document application design standards, technical patterns, operational guidelines, and support considerations in collaboration with architecture and engineering teams
Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and capability building programs for engineering, product, delivery, and technical teams

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Relevant Job Experience
Professional Experience

10 plus years of experience in application development, technical architecture, solution architecture, enterprise systems, or technology delivery roles
5 plus years of experience in application architecture, technical solution design, or enterprise wide solution architecture
Proven experience designing and delivering large scale enterprise application solutions across custom applications, SaaS platforms, cloud services, and packaged business systems
Strong experience translating business requirements into end-to-end technical designs covering applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure, security, cloud, and operations
Experience working with Architecture Review Boards, enterprise architecture teams, and domain architects to review, govern, and align solution designs
Strong background in application modernization, platform consolidation, cloud adoption, technical debt reduction, and legacy system rationalization
Practical experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including application hosting, deployment patterns, scalability, security, monitoring, and cost awareness
Experience working with integration teams on APIs, middleware, event based flows, data exchange, and system interaction patterns
Experience guiding engineering teams on application design, technical patterns, DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, testing, deployment, and production readiness
Retail, ecommerce, hospitality, supply chain, or enterprise business systems experience strongly preferred

Technical Skills

Application Architecture: Enterprise applications, custom platforms, SaaS solutions, packaged systems, modular design, service design, API first architecture, scalability, maintainability, and supportability
Solution Design: End to end technical design, solution options, architecture tradeoffs, risk assessment, cost versus benefit analysis, transition architecture, and implementation guidance
AI Enabled Architecture: Practical understanding of generative AI, machine learning enabled applications, AI APIs, intelligent search, automation, prompt enabled workflows, responsible AI, data privacy, model integration, and AI solution governance
Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, hybrid cloud, application hosting, cloud services, deployment patterns, cloud security, scalability, resilience, and cost optimization
Integration Design: REST APIs, event driven architecture, middleware, messaging, file based integrations, data exchange patterns, and system interaction models in partnership with the integration architect
Infrastructure Design: Hosting, compute, storage, networking, load balancing, application gateways, backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and operational support considerations
Security by Design: IAM, SSO, MFA, role based access, encryption, secure APIs, data protection, vulnerability management, application security, privacy, and compliance alignment
DevOps and Automation: CI/CD, release management, environment strategy, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, automated testing, deployment automation, and infrastructure as code awareness
Observability and Operations: Monitoring, logging, alerting, performance management, incident readiness, production support, operational handover, and service reliability
Architecture Documentation: Solution architecture documents, application diagrams, system context diagrams, data flow diagrams, deployment views, technical design documents, and architecture decision records

Required Leadership Skills

new_jobs.description:
About Marex

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

For more information visit https://www.marex.com/

Vacancy Number: VN3065 & VN3127

Department Description

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights, and analytics.

This role sits within the Technology department reporting to the Global IT Service Manager. Technology is central to the success of our organisation. The 290+ strong global Technology Department and delivers differentiation, scalability and security for the business. Technology provides digital tools, software services and infrastructure globally to all business groups. Software development and application support teams work in agile ‘streams’ aligned to specific business areas. Our other teams work enterprise-wide to provide critical services including our global service desk, network and system infrastructure, IT operations, design, enterprise architecture and information security.

The Software Development function creates and maintains applications, frameworks and other software components to deliver to business requirements. Developers conceive, specify, design, engineer, document, test, and deliver bug fixes as needed to provide high quality software solutions. Each Development team is aligned to one of Marex’s business divisions and works for that division under Head of Technology and corresponding Application Support team.

Role Summary

As a Software Developer specializing in C# .NET or React, you will be a pivotal member of our Software Development team, contributing to the creation and enhancement of secure, responsive web applications tailored for front-to-back trading technology. Your expertise in C# .NET or React and your strong emphasis on testing will be instrumental in delivering robust and reliable applications. In this role, you will use your architectural experience to help mature our existing software and efficiently migrate legacy platforms to the cloud, working closely with the platform engineering team to ensure seamless integration and deployment.

Design, code and test all components of modern web applications.
Contribute to the overall architecture and design of the technology created/maintained by the development delivery team.
Develop solutions to a high standard that is maintainable, testable and meets the requirement’s acceptance criteria.
Adhere to development best practices and processes.
Communicate with team members, introduce ideas and keep abreast of the latest technologies.
Liaise with business users to gather application requirements.
Ensure delivered systems are of production quality. Ensure software is adequately documented for handover to the business.
Follow coding standards and defined development process.
Resolve third line support issues in a professional and timely manner.
Be pragmatic & delivery focused.
Ensure solutions are not over engineered, always lean towards simplicity over unnecessary complexity

All staff:

Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS.
Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
At all times complying with the FCA’s Code of Conduct

To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
To escalate risk events immediately
To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Experience in C# .NET, React/Angular, JavaScript, Typescript
Experience of NoSQL or RDMS databases

Modern CI/CD and DevOps practices

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

,

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
👋 A bit of background on Rotageek

Rotageek helps businesses optimise staff scheduling through data-driven technology. By combining machine learning and advanced algorithms, we help organisations forecast demand, improve workforce management and give employees greater control over their schedules.

Our solutions drive operational efficiency, improve customer experiences and help reduce staff turnover across the retail and healthcare sectors. Rotageek is now part of the ELMO Software group, strengthening our ability to deliver industry-leading workforce management solutions as part of a broader HR technology ecosystem.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate.

Rotageek is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

💛 Our values: what we live by

🫶 Start With People
: You champion the customer experience, create psychological safety and help the whole team deliver with confidence.

🤝 Own It, Together
: You take responsibility for quality outcomes, collaborate across disciplines and help turn incidents into learning.

🙌 Clear Is Kind
: You make defects, risks, coverage and quality decisions clear, actionable and respectful.

💡 Why this role is so important

Our customers rely on Rotageek to support important workforce decisions. As a Software Engineer, you’ll help build the services, APIs and integrations that make those experiences reliable, secure and easy to extend.

You’ll take ownership of well-scoped features and components, turning clear requirements into simple, robust and maintainable C# and .NET solutions. You’ll work closely with Engineering, QA, Product and Data colleagues from design through to production.

This is a role for an engineer who cares about the whole journey, not just the code. You’ll think about testability, security, performance, observability and the way application data moves into reliable customer-facing experiences.

You’ll also use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of your delivery workflow. You’ll use them to accelerate implementation, testing and refactoring, while applying your judgement to validate the output for correctness, security and architectural fit.

🛠️ What You’ll Be Doing

Break down well-scoped features into deliverable tasks, identifying dependencies and communicating progress, risks and decisions.
Design medium-complexity components with clear responsibilities, well-defined interfaces and sensible separation of concerns.
Write automated tests covering core behaviour and common edge cases, working with QA to ensure the right coverage at the right level.
Apply established security practices, including OWASP principles, secure handling of data and appropriate escalation of risks.
Use logs, metrics and traces to monitor, troubleshoot and improve production behaviour.
Participate in constructive code reviews that improve logic, style, performance and security while helping colleagues grow.
Work with Data Engineering colleagues on interfaces, data contracts, data quality and operational failure modes.
Contribute to incident response, post-incident learning and continuous improvement of the services you support.
Document technical decisions and operational knowledge so the team can understand, support and extend what you build.

✅ What You’ll Bring

Professional experience building software with C# and .NET.
Strong fundamentals in object-oriented design, APIs, SQL, automated testing and debugging.
Experience delivering medium-complexity features within an established architecture.
A practical understanding of secure development, performance, reliability and observability.
Confidence participating in code reviews and explaining technical decisions clearly.
The ability to take ownership of work from a well-scoped ticket through to production, including testing, documentation, monitoring and follow-through.
A collaborative, customer-focused approach to agile delivery.
The judgement to use AI productively while validating and owning everything it produces.

🌱 Nice To Have, But Not Essential

Experience working closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture or analytics teams.
Practical understanding of data modelling, data quality, lineage, data contracts or transformation pipelines.
Experience building reliable ingestion or integration workflows, event-driven services or messaging-based systems.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, or with BI and semantic-layer concepts.
Experience working with multi-tenant systems, row-level access controls, PII or GDPR-sensitive data.
Experience supporting a migration from legacy reporting or BI technology to a governed, modern data platform.

You don’t need experience with every tool or concept listed above. We’re more interested in your engineering fundamentals, problem-solving approach, curiosity and ability to learn.

🤝 How You’ll Work

You use AI-assisted delivery thoughtfully, validating generated code and tests before they become part of the product.
You favour simple solutions, evaluate existing libraries and services before building new ones, and avoid unnecessary complexity.
You take ownership from ticket to production, including documentation, testing, monitoring and follow-through.
You are comfortable explaining technical choices, listening to alternatives and collaborating across Engineering, QA, Product and Data.
You connect implementation decisions to customer value, reliability, cost and the wider product experience.
You share knowledge through pairing, reviews and clear documentation, while asking for help early when a problem needs wider input.

📈 The impact you’ll make

Customers receive reliable features that are easy for the team to understand and extend.
Components have clear boundaries, sensible abstractions and automated coverage.
Production issues are diagnosed quickly because the right signals and documentation are in place.
The team can trust your delivery, your reviews and your communication.
Application and data integrations have clear ownership, interfaces and failure behaviour.
Data-dependent features work coherently from source system through to analytics and customer experience.

🔧 The tools and ways of working

C# and .NET for services, APIs and application development.
Strong SQL and relational data stores, with an interest in how application data becomes reliable analytics data.
Automated unit and integration testing, Git, CI/CD and environment-aware delivery.
Observability through logging, metrics, tracing and production diagnostics.
Cloud-hosted services, with AWS experience useful in our wider platform environment.
AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or Codex, used with disciplined review and validation.
Agile planning, code review, incident response and collaborative technical documentation.

🎁 Why you’ll love it here

Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
Flexible, hybrid working, with collaboration across the team and time to focus when you need it.
25 days’ holiday, plus one extra day after three years, and your birthday off.
UK bank holidays, plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve afternoons off.
Private medical insurance with enhanced mental health, dental and optical coverage via AXA.
Employee Assistance Programme, support when you need it.
Life insurance at 2x salary and matched pension contributions of 5%.
Two volunteer days per year, give back to causes that matter to you.
Access to Mintago for financial wellbeing, discounts and expert advice.
Retail discount scheme, perks and savings just for being part of our team.

🚀 The hiring process: let’s make it personal!

Screening call:
A virtual chat with one of our team to learn more about your experience, what excites you about the role and how you align with our people-first culture.

Competency interview:
You’ll meet the hiring manager and talk through your approach to software design, development, testing, debugging, security and collaborating across Engineering, QA, Product and Data.

Final stage interview:
You’ll meet members of the wider team and explore how you would build reliable services, make sound technical decisions and contribute to a strong engineering culture.

Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business.
This is an initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.

The Impact
– Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering:
Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership

🏆 Global recognition:
Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges:
Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year-on-year, with over 11,000 e-motorbikes financed and demand climbing

🌱 Real climate impact:
Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event-driven microservices with real-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end-to-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting-edge .NET development with purpose-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

Technical Environment 💻

Languages & frameworks: C#/.NET
Cloud: We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
Architecture: Event-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana
Engineering culture: DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery
AI tooling: We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

High quality output
Observability and monitoring
Automated testing in all environments, including production
Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

What You Need

We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development.

Required Experience:

Strong grasp of C# .NET development
Experience with event-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Microservices architecture experience
Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP
Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Testing and deployment expertise
DevOps culture mindset
Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

Location & Benefits

Initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role
Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones
Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍
We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model, with M-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Connected 📱: 6 million smartphone customers, 2.5 million first-time smartphone users
Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents
Green 🌱: 11,000+ e-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year-on-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

Ready to build C# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern backend engineering?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritise well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Apply now to join our mission of transforming lives across Africa through technology.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com
.

but may close earlier depending on application volumes.

2 year Programme: Starting September 2027
Annual Salary Review

Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime

Working with other departments within the company, learning a general overview of the business.

– Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership

High quality output

Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise integration / middleware applications
Strong hands-on experience with FIX 4.4, including message structures, tags, session management, routing, order lifecycle messages and execution reporting

Financial services integration experience, particularly capital markets, payments, trading or settlement
Experience with financial-market messaging standards
Experience developing transaction orchestration in regulated/high-availability environments

new_jobs.title: Azure Integration Architect
new_jobs.description:
Vi omdefinierar vad ett datakonsultbolag kan vara och åstadkomma

Epical är inte bara ännu ett konsultbolag. Vi har en tydlig ambition: att omdefiniera vad ett datakonsultbolag kan vara och åstadkomma. Allt vi gör börjar och slutar med förtroende. För oss är förtroende inte bara ett värdeord, det är grunden för varje framgångsrikt samarbete. Som konsulter handlar vårt jobb om mer än att leverera tjänster och rådgivning. Vi tar ansvar och ser möjligheter att bidra till en mer rättvis värld genom vår expertis inom integration, dataanalys och digitalt förtroende.

Är du en affärsorienterad integrationsarkitekt som brinner för att skapa värde genom smarta integrationslösningar? Hos Epical får du arbeta med kunder i olika branscher och utvecklas tillsammans med några av branschens främsta integrationsexperter.

Din roll som Azure Integration Architect

Som Azure Integration Architect hos Epical får du en nyckelroll inom:

Rådgivning kring integrationsarkitektur Du samarbetar med kunder för att utforma och implementera integrations-, och API-arkitekturer som matchar deras unika behov och ambitioner.
Ledning av teknisk leverans Du guidar ditt team genom hela resan; från planering och kravanalys, till design och implementation, samtidigt som du säkerställer smidiga lösningar med verklig effekt.
Presales Du visar upp Epicals integrationsexpertis och skapar förtroende och engagemang hos potentiella kunder.
Samarbete i team Du leder arbetsgrupper och främjar en kultur av lärande och gemensam framgång inom vår teambaserade leveransmodell.

Vi är stolta över att leverera integrationslösningar av hög kvalitet på flera olika molnplattformar. I takt med att vi växer tar vi oss an alltmer komplexa projekt i dynamiska miljöer. Oavsett om du föredrar en teknisk, handfast roll, ett strategiskt rådgivande fokus, eller en kombination av båda, på Epical kan vi skräddarsy din roll utifrån dina styrkor och ambitioner.

Vad vi letar efter

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen bör du ha:

Flera års praktisk erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services (AIS) och dess centrala komponenter (expempelvis Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid och Functions)
Förmåga att balansera både helhetsbilden och kundens detaljerade krav, och säkerställa lösningar som möter affärsmål samtidigt som de är tekniskt robusta.
Dokumenterad ledarerfarenhet, med vana att guida och coacha tekniska leveransteam genom hela integrationsprojekt.
Teknisk bakgrund som gör att du förstår utvecklingsprocesser och arkitekturer, även om du inte längre kodar dagligen.
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift, med förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och professionellt i olika sammanhang.

Det är meriterande om du har
erfarenhet av att arbeta i en konsultmiljö samt med BizTalk eller bredare kompetens inom Azure-plattformen

Varför välja Epical?

Hos Epical står förtroende och samarbete i centrum för allt vi gör. Här är vad du kan förvänta dig som en del av vårt team:

Work-life balance: Flexibla möjligheter att arbeta hemifrån och en arbetsmiljö som sätter ditt välmående i första rummet.
Stimulerande uppdrag: Du får jobba med spännande projekt hos stora företagskunder i komplexa integrationsmiljöer.
Möjlighet att växa i din karriär: Forma din roll i takt med att du utvecklas, och lär av branschens främsta experter inom integration.
Trygga förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig ersättning, utbildningsmöjligheter och certifieringar som hjälper dig att lyckas.
En organisation med ett tydligt syfte: Bli en del av ett bolag som är dedikerat till att skapa en mer rättvis värld genom att använda data och teknik på ett ansvarsfullt sätt.

Praktisk information

Alla roller på Epical är tillsvidareanställningar, med flexibilitet att arbeta hemifrån eller från något av våra kontor runt om i Sverige (Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Västerås, Örebro och Skövde). För att kvalificera dig behöver du vara bosatt i Sverige och ha giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Observera att säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslagen kan krävas för vissa uppdrag.

Låter det här som möjligheten du har väntat på? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

new_jobs.description:
We are seeking an AI Agent Developer
to design, develop, integrate, and maintain production-ready AI solutions. The role will focus on AI agents, LLM-powered applications, orchestration services, APIs, and secure integrations with internal and third-party systems.
A primary focus will be the contact center, integrating AI solutions with Genesys Cloud
to support virtual agents, real-time agent assistance, knowledge retrieval, interaction summarization, workflow automation, and other contact-center use cases.
This is a hands-on software-development role. The developer will build applications and services that enable AI agents to retrieve information, apply business rules, call authorized APIs, interact with company systems, and perform controlled actions.

Key Responsibilities
AI Agent Development
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered applications.
Build agents capable of understanding requests, retrieving information, applying business rules, selecting tools, calling APIs, and completing authorized actions.
Develop reusable tools, APIs, and orchestration services for internal applications, CRM systems, databases, and third-party platforms.
Manage prompts, conversation context, workflow states, tool selection, structured outputs, retries, timeouts, and error handling.
Evaluate LLMs and AI services from different providers and support solutions from proof of concept through production.
Design reusable AI configurations for different departments, channels, languages, and use cases.

Contact Center AI
Develop AI solutions integrated with Genesys Cloud
for voice, web chat, SMS, WhatsApp, and other supported channels.
Build virtual agents capable of answering questions, gathering information, identifying or authenticating members, executing approved actions, and transferring interactions to human agents.
Develop real-time agent assistance for intent identification, knowledge retrieval, recommended responses, next-best actions, policy guidance, workflow support, message drafting, and escalation detection.
Implement transcription, summarization, categorization, disposition, and after-call documentation.
Integrate AI with CRM, member, contract, reservation, benefit, payment, and account systems through APIs, webhooks, and Genesys Data Actions.
Preserve relevant context during AI-to-human transfers and implement appropriate fallback and escalation processes.
Ensure AI actions comply with business rules, authorization requirements, and operational policies.
Support English- and Spanish-language interactions.

Knowledge Assistant
Build an internal AI assistant using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
to provide contact-center employees with reliable answers from approved company knowledge.
Integrate approved procedures, policies, club benefits, reservations, cancellations, payments, property information, promotions, training materials, FAQs, scripts, and operational documentation.
Provide citations or source links whenever possible and prevent unsupported information from being presented as fact.
Implement role-based access to ensure employees only receive authorized information.
Develop document ingestion, indexing, versioning, expiration, re-indexing, and content-approval processes.
Implement feedback mechanisms to identify and correct inaccurate or outdated responses.

Software & Systems Integration
Build backend services, APIs, middleware, and event-driven integrations for AI applications.
Integrate with Genesys Cloud, CRM and member systems, reservation and contract platforms, billing and payment systems, communication-consent platforms, SMS/WhatsApp, email, knowledge sources, and third-party providers.
Create secure tool interfaces that control which systems, data, and operations each AI agent can access.
Separate AI reasoning from critical business rules and ensure transactions are validated by source systems before confirmations are communicated.
Implement authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, timeouts, logging, monitoring, and failure recovery.

AI Quality & Testing
Develop automated tests for AI agents, prompts, tools, integrations, and business workflows.
Create realistic evaluation scenarios in English and Spanish.
Evaluate answer accuracy, retrieval relevance, intent recognition, tool selection, API accuracy, business-rule compliance, escalation behavior, hallucination risk, response time, and security.
Perform regression testing when models, prompts, tools, documents, or business rules change.
Test ambiguous, incomplete, incorrect, and potentially malicious inputs.
Work with QA and contact-center teams to establish acceptance criteria and review failed interactions.

Security, Privacy & Governance
Protect member information, contracts, reservations, payments, credentials, and PII.
Ensure company and member information is not used to train public AI models.
Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, encryption, data masking, secure secret management, and least-privilege access.
Protect against prompt injection, unauthorized tool execution, data leakage, malicious documents, and other AI-specific risks.
Minimize sensitive information in prompts, responses, logs, and monitoring systems.
Maintain appropriate audit records of AI requests, sources, tool calls, actions, outcomes, and errors.
Ensure SMS and WhatsApp workflows comply with communication-consent requirements.
Support applicable privacy, PCI DSS, security, and audit requirements.

Monitoring & Production Support
Implement structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerts.
Monitor adoption, answer accuracy, retrieval quality, API failures, response times, transfer and containment rates, unsupported responses, security issues, and AI costs.
Diagnose and resolve production issues across AI applications and integrations.
Analyze interactions to identify knowledge gaps, workflow failures, and improvement opportunities.
Continuously improve prompts, tools, retrieval, integrations, and conversational workflows.
Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, support procedures, and operational runbooks.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of professional software-development experience.

Strong experience with C# and .NET
for backend and enterprise application development.
Experience developing REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
Practical experience developing applications using LLMs or generative AI
.
Understanding of AI agents, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, conversation-state management, and AI evaluation.
Experience with relational databases and SQL.
Knowledge of authentication, authorization, RBAC, and secure API development.
Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD.
Ability to troubleshoot distributed applications and integrations.
Ability to translate business and operational requirements into reliable technical solutions.
Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud
, including APIs, Architect, Data Actions, routing, messaging, knowledge, transcription, or agent assistance.
Experience developing conversational AI for voice, chat, SMS, or WhatsApp.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs
, or other enterprise LLM platforms.
Experience with AI-agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, Azure AI Search, vector databases, or enterprise-search platforms.
Experience using Python for AI applications, integrations, evaluation, or data processing.
Experience with Angular or other modern frontend frameworks.
Experience developing bilingual English/Spanish conversational applications.
Experience integrating AI with CRM, reservation, payment, or contact-center systems.
Experience in travel, hospitality, vacation ownership, loyalty, or member-service operations.
Familiarity with contact-center operations, privacy, consent management, PCI DSS, PII protection, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, and DevSecOps.

Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M-KOPA Mobility, our fast-growing e-mobility business.
This is an initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.

The Impact
– Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering:
Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership

🏆 Global recognition:
Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges:
Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year-on-year, with over 11,000 e-motorbikes financed and demand climbing

🌱 Real climate impact:
Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event-driven microservices with real-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end-to-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting-edge .NET development with purpose-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

Technical Environment 💻

Languages & frameworks: C#/.NET
Cloud: We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
Architecture: Event-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana
Engineering culture: DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery
AI tooling: We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

High quality output
Observability and monitoring
Automated testing in all environments, including production
Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

What You Need

We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first-order concerns in development.

Required Experience:

Strong grasp of C# .NET development
Experience with event-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Microservices architecture experience
Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP
Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Testing and deployment expertise
DevOps culture mindset
Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

Location & Benefits

Initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract, with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role
Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones
Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍
We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model, with M-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Connected 📱: 6 million smartphone customers, 2.5 million first-time smartphone users
Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents
Green 🌱: 11,000+ e-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year-on-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

Ready to build C# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern backend engineering?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritise well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Apply now to join our mission of transforming lives across Africa through technology.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com
.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

En el puesto de Ingeniero de software en Naxogon, te encargarás del diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de servicios y aplicaciones back-end, asegurando su rendimiento, seguridad y escalabilidad. As a Senior D365/Power Platform developer you will participate in projects of different sector, programming and

developing workflows, plugins and business process actions to achieve project and client goals on a very dynamic

environment.

The opportunity

As a member of our team in GDS office in Malaga, Spain, you’ll have a chance to extend your knowledge &

experience by working on the interesting projects with the newest technologies and approaches. You’ll support

clients in choosing the most suitable business solution and take part in digital transformation.

Your key responsibilities

Analysis, configuration, and development of proposed solutions in the projects in which they

participate Configuration and customization of Dynamics CRM environments

Development of Workflows, Plugins, Business Process Actions for Dynamics CRM Development of

applications with Power platform technology (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Pages)

Project monitoring with agile methodologies

Skills and attributes for success

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information System or related technical field
+2 years hands on experience with Power Platform.
Experience working with workflows, plugins and business process.
Object Oriented programming skills as (Java, C#, .NET)
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

Ideally, you’ll also have

Power Platform certifications PL- 900, PL- 400
VS.NET language (C# language), Net Core, JavaScript, JQuery, CSS What To increase the value of our

Microsoft team in order to provide better service to our clients and help with digital transformation in a

changing and dynamic

Good communication skills.

What we look for

We are a dynamic team of passionate specialists, working in international teams all over the world. As part of our

team, we look for “out of the box thinking" professionals that will build good relationships with our clients. If you

want to be a part of this journey, we are looking forward to seeing you on board!

What we offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations –

Argentina, China, India, Philippines, Poland, UK, Hungary and Spain – and with teams from all EY service lines,

geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to

advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS,

you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll

introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout

your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact,

your way.

Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the

world needs.

Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to

help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and

build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and

help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find

new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

new_jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer (Selenium)
Agentic AI Platform Architect
new_jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At the intersection of cloud engineering and artificial intelligence, this role offers a rare opportunity to architect the foundational platform that powers the next generation of intelligent, autonomous systems across a global science and technology enterprise. As Agentic AI Platform Architect, you will be actively designing, implementing, integrating and operating cloud-native backend systems that together form a cohesive ecosystem for Agentic AI applications. In particular, you will focus on the evolution of a cloud-based agentic AI platform that enables building and orchestrating agents and is connected into the wider ecosystem. You will be hands-on in writing production code, building pipelines, owning deployments, and taking end-to-end accountability for the solutions you deliver. In addition, you will be able to work with and guide other team members. If you thrive building things that matter, in a team that values quality, ownership, and continuous improvement, this role is for you.

Your Key Responsibilities

Own the platform architecture, technical roadmap and ADRs within the broader agentic AI strategy.
Design, build and operate the multi-tenant Kubernetes platform using Amazon EKS, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD and Argo Workflows, together with a team of engineers.
Build repeatable onboarding, promotion, recovery and decommissioning capabilities through Azure DevOps and GitOps.
Implement identity and tenant isolation across OIDC, Kubernetes RBAC and impersonation, AWS workload identity and secrets management.
Design secure integrations with models, tools, MCP/A2A services and other enterprise platforms.
Own operational readiness, including SLOs, telemetry, agent and LLM tracing, evaluation, capacity, cost, incident response, upgrades, backup/restore and rollback.
Develop and review production Python, Terraform modules, Helm charts and pipeline templates.
Establish technical standards, documentation and reusable platform patterns, and mentor other engineers.

In return, we offer direct impact on life-changing R&D, a high-autonomy engineering culture with experienced peers, flexible working models, and the purpose-driven environment of a global science and technology company.

Who You Are

Mindset & Ways of Working

Strong sense of ownership and accountability – you build it, you run it.
Curious and eager to learn; comfortable adapting to evolving technologies and requirements.
Collaborative team player in a cross-functional, international environment.
Ability to influence technical decisions in a fact-based manner, clearly explaining the underlying rationale and gaining stakeholder and technical team buy-in.

Experience & Qualifications

University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
8+ years of relevant experience building secure, scalable, resilient cloud-native backend systems at enterprise scale.
Experience in architecting complex cloud-native solutions and in guiding teams in their implementation.
Hands-on experience designing and operating production Kubernetes platforms, preferably Amazon EKS, including RBAC, networking, ingress, autoscaling, upgrades and troubleshooting.
Strong AWS platform engineering experience across EKS, ECR, IAM/workload identity, VPC/private connectivity, ALB/WAF, Route 53, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and S3.
Strong Infrastructure as Code and GitOps experience using Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD and Git.
Experience building and governing CI/CD pipelines, preferably with Azure DevOps.
Strong production Python experience, including boto3, API integration, automated testing and operational automation.
Experience with OIDC/OAuth2/JWT, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, Kubernetes RBAC and secure secrets management.
Practical experience building or operating GenAI or agentic systems, including tool integration, state and memory, evaluation, observability and failure handling.
Understanding of MCP and A2A, particularly authentication, authorization, service boundaries and enterprise governance.
Business-fluent English (written and spoken)

Nice To Have

AgentCore, Amazon Bedrock
OpenTelemetry, Langfuse or comparable agent and LLM observability platforms.
Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, SQS or similar distributed state and messaging services.
Argo Workflows, Keycloak or another enterprise identity provider, and External Secrets Operator.

What we offer:
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
